entries: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.
Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.
Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.
Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.

Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.
Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

title.zh-TW: 開放 run_workflow 工具，讓子代理分工跑 Python 流程
title.en: The run_workflow tool is now available for subagents to run Python workflows

body.zh-TW: 當你手上有整批問卷或報告要整理，單靠單一視窗逐份處理太慢時，現在所有人都能使用 `run_workflow` 工具。⟦想像以前大廚得一個人從洗菜做到擺盤，現在直接把切菜、熬湯、擺盤分派給多位助手平行或分階段處理，最後由他匯總上菜，連廚具都自帶齊全。⟧你在跟代理整理大量資料或拆解多步驟任務時，只要請它啟用 `run_workflow`，代理就能執行 Python 工作流程腳本（一串照步驟跑的自動化程式）。這份腳本會把工作平行派發或分階段交給多個子代理執行，最後再把結果彙整起來。即使你的電腦沒有另外安裝 Python，它也能直接使用 CLI（指令列工具）隨附的 Python 來跑。
body.en: When you have a whole batch of surveys or reports to organize and handling them one by one in a single window is too slow, everyone can now use the `run_workflow` tool. ⟦Imagine a head chef who used to handle everything from washing vegetables to plating alone, but now delegates chopping, simmering soup, and plating to multiple assistants in parallel or in stages before combining the dishes to serve, with all the kitchenware already included.⟧ When you are organizing large amounts of data or breaking down multi-step tasks with the agent, just ask it to enable `run_workflow`, and it can run a Python workflow script (an automated program that follows a sequence of steps). This script fans work out to multiple subagents in parallel or in stages, then combines their results. Even if Python is not separately installed on your computer, it can run directly using the Python bundled with the CLI (command-line tool).

items.original: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

title.zh-TW: 管理員設定新增 pluginControls，非企業方案也能控管外掛
title.en: Admin settings add pluginControls so non-enterprise teams can manage plugins

body.zh-TW: 沒有導入 Gemini Enterprise 的團隊，過去很難統一控管成員電腦裡的外掛。⟦好比學校圖書室依規定調整借閱，完全停用時連館內現有書架都封起來不准翻閱，若只關閉新書採購櫃位，大家手邊已借出的書仍能繼續使用。⟧管理員現在可以在受控管的管理員設定裡加入 `pluginControls` 區段，按需求選擇兩種控制開關：`pluginsDisabled` 用來停用所有外掛（包含內建外掛），並禁止安裝或啟用任何外掛。`marketplaceDisabled` 則只會關閉外掛市集，已經安裝好的外掛仍可照常運作。若是 Gemini Enterprise 使用者，依舊會遵循所屬組織在 Cloud Console（Google 雲端管理主控台）設定的政策。
body.en: Teams that have not adopted Gemini Enterprise previously had a hard time centrally controlling plugins on members' computers. ⟦Think of a school library adjusting its lending rules: a full shutdown seals off even the existing shelves so nothing can be browsed, whereas closing only the new-book acquisition desk lets everyone keep using the books they have already borrowed.⟧ Admins can now add a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings and choose between two control switches as needed: `pluginsDisabled` disables all plugins (including built-in ones) and blocks installing or enabling any plugin. Meanwhile, `marketplaceDisabled` only turns off the plugin marketplace, so already installed plugins continue working as usual. Gemini Enterprise users still follow their organization's policy set in Cloud Console (Google's web-based admin hub).

items.original: Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改採直接翻查加快沙盒外指令審查
title.en: Auto mode switches to direct lookups to speed up out-of-sandbox command reviews

body.zh-TW: 開著自動模式讓 AI 幫忙跑指令時，只要指令準備跨出終端機沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境），審查步驟就常讓人等得心急甚至逾時。⟦猶如編輯審查稿件時，以前每確認一個細節都要發公文去外單位查證，常常等到逾期；現在手邊就有通訊錄和檔案夾能直接翻找，立刻就能決定放行或擋下。⟧以前審查員每做一項檢查，都得另外啟動一個沙盒內的指令來跑。現在審查員可以直接搜尋對話內容、列出資料夾清單並搜尋檔案，因此能更快做出判斷，也較少發生逾時。
body.en: When Auto mode is on and the AI runs commands for you, the review step often made you wait anxiously or even timed out whenever a command was about to leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated security environment for execution). ⟦An editor reviewing a manuscript used to send an official memo to an outside office for every detail they needed to verify, often missing deadlines; now they have the directory and folders right at hand to flip through and decide immediately whether to approve or block it.⟧ Previously, the reviewer had to launch a separate sandboxed command for each check. Now the reviewer can search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly, allowing it to decide faster and time out less often.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

title.zh-TW: 改善 /resume 載入效能並支援短 ID 與查無提示
title.en: Improve /resume loading performance and add short ID and not-found support

body.zh-TW: 想接續昨天的長對話繼續工作，輸入 `/resume` 卻只看到畫面一直卡在「Loading conversations...」嗎？⟦就像到大型行李寄物區領包裹一樣，以前店員要把每個櫃子都打開清點一遍才讓你挑，人一多就卡在門口；現在只對櫃號前幾碼就能精準取出，遇到空號也會直接告訴你。⟧現在開啟對話選擇器時，不再抓取每個開啟中對話的完整歷史紀錄，因此在較長的工作階段裡不會再卡在載入畫面。用 `/resume <id>` 指定對話時，只要輸入的開頭字元能唯一對應到一個對話（例如狀態列顯示的短 ID）就能直接恢復。如果輸入了不存在的 ID，畫面會明確回報 `conversation <id> not found`，不再靜悄悄地直接打開選擇清單。
body.en: Want to pick up yesterday's long conversation where you left off, only to type `/resume` and see the screen stuck on "Loading conversations..."? ⟦At a large luggage check counter, attendants previously had to open and inventory every locker before letting you pick, causing a bottleneck at the door; now matching just the first few digits of a locker number pulls out the exact item, and an empty number is reported to you right away.⟧ Opening the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on the loading screen in longer sessions. When specifying a conversation with `/resume <id>`, any prefix that uniquely matches one conversation (such as the short ID shown in the status line) resumes it directly. If you enter an ID that does not exist, it clearly reports `conversation <id> not found` instead of silently opening the picker.

items.original: Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽器子代理錄影改用 Chrome 內建錄製並存成 .mp4
title.en: Browser subagent recordings now use Chrome built-in capture and save as .mp4

body.zh-TW: 請 `/browser` 子代理代為操作網頁時，它錄下的工作階段影像現在有了新變化。以前這類瀏覽器操作錄影會存成 `.webm` 檔，現在則改由 Chrome 內建的螢幕錄影功能進行錄製，直接產出 `.mp4` 檔案。⟦彷彿活動側錄換成場地內建的錄影機，交片的格式也跟著換了；原本用一種規格收片，現在改收另一種。⟧下次你打開 `/browser` 子代理的工作階段錄影回顧操作過程時，拿到的就會是 `.mp4` 檔案。
body.en: When you ask the `/browser` subagent to operate web pages for you, its session video recordings have a new update. Previously these browser operation recordings were saved as `.webm` files, whereas now they are recorded using Chrome's built-in screen recording feature to output `.mp4` files directly. ⟦Switching an event shoot to the venue's built-in recorder changes the delivery format too; where footage used to arrive in one specification, it now comes in another.⟧ Next time you open a `/browser` subagent session recording to review the steps taken, you will get an `.mp4` file.

items.original: Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

title.zh-TW: 修復 HTTP MCP 重新導向時誤傳自訂標頭的安全性問題
title.en: Fix security issue where HTTP MCP redirects forwarded custom headers

body.zh-TW: 替遠端 HTTP MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器設定自訂標頭後，只要對方回傳重新導向就可能出狀況。像 API 金鑰這類自訂標頭先前可能會被轉送給其他主機，現在這項安全性問題已經修好，只會送給原本設定的伺服器來源。
body.en: After configuring custom headers for a remote HTTP MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server, returning a redirect could cause trouble. Custom headers like API keys could previously be forwarded to a different host, and this security issue is now fixed so they are sent only to the originally configured server origin.

items.original: Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

title.zh-TW: 忽略異常的終端機視窗尺寸回報避免畫面凍結
title.en: Ignore abnormal terminal window-size reports to prevent UI freezes

body.zh-TW: 操作 CLI（指令列工具）時，程式有時會突然凍結或佔用過多記憶體。這是因為誤傳的逸出字元序列（控制游標或畫面的特殊字元組合）送出了負數或極端龐大的視窗尺寸回報，過去終端機介面會照單全收，現在這些無效回報會被直接忽略。
body.en: When using the CLI (command-line tool), the program could sometimes freeze suddenly or consume excessive memory. This happened because stray escape sequences (special character combinations that control the cursor or screen) sent negative or extremely large window-size reports that the terminal UI previously accepted as-is, and these invalid reports are now ignored.

items.original: Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

title.zh-TW: 修復 agy acp 登入備援、特殊字元名稱與錯誤回報問題
title.en: Fix agy acp login fallback, special-character names, and error reporting

body.zh-TW:
使用 `agy acp` 時，過去容易撞上的四個問題現在已經修復。

執行 `agy acp --login` 後，就算 `settings.json` 指定了缺少憑證的驗證方式（例如設成 `gemini-api-key` 卻沒給 `GEMINI_API_KEY`），工作階段也不會再跳出「Authentication required」失敗，CLI 會改用已儲存的登入資料作為備援。

當 ACP 用戶端傳入名稱含空白或其他特殊字元的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，送出提示詞不再因此失敗。回合失敗時，現在會回報模型或額度這類具體錯誤，不再只顯示「Agent execution terminated due to error.」。編輯完成後送出的差異比對中，`oldText` 與 `newText` 結尾也不再多出一個多餘的換行符號。
body.en:
Four issues you could easily run into when using `agy acp` have now been fixed.

After running `agy acp --login`, even if `settings.json` specifies an authentication method without a credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), the session no longer fails with "Authentication required", and the CLI falls back to your saved login.

When the ACP client passes an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server whose name contains spaces or other special characters, sending prompts no longer fails because of it. When a turn fails, it now reports specific errors such as a model or quota error instead of only showing "Agent execution terminated due to error.". In the diffs sent after edits complete, `oldText` and `newText` also no longer carry an extra trailing newline.

items.original: Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

title.zh-TW: 修妥 UTF-8 BOM 檔頭導致設定與外掛驗證誤判的問題
title.en: Fix UTF-8 BOM headers causing settings and plugin validation misreads

body.zh-TW: 檔案若在儲存時帶有 UTF-8 BOM（用來標記編碼的隱藏開頭標記），過去常會被錯誤處理。現在包含這三種情況都已修復：首次執行時會正確套用 `settings.json` 裡的 `"modelProvider"` 設定；`agy acp` 也會正常載入你的設定與驗證選項，不再退回使用預設值作為備援。對這類 `hooks.json`（設定特定事件觸發動作的檔案）執行 `agy plugin validate` 時，也會跑完所有檢查並回報真正的語法錯誤與行號，不再怪罪到 BOM 頭上。
body.en: Files saved with a UTF-8 BOM (a hidden leading marker that indicates encoding) were previously often mishandled. Three such cases are now fixed: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is properly applied on the first run, and `agy acp` loads your settings and authentication options normally instead of falling back to defaults. When running `agy plugin validate` on such a `hooks.json` (the file that configures actions triggered by specific events), it also runs all checks and reports the real syntax error and line number instead of blaming the BOM.

items.original: Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

title.zh-TW: 修復搭配遠端代理接續對話時互動提示誤開新串的問題
title.en: Fix interactive prompts starting a new thread when resuming with a remote agent

body.zh-TW: 想在遠端代理接續舊對話並馬上送出一句互動提示時，原本的指令組合卻沒把話接回同一串。過去將 `-i`（或 `--prompt-interactive`）搭配 `--remote-agent` 與 `--conversation` 或 `--continue` 使用時，提示詞會誤開成新對話；現在工具會等歷史紀錄載入完成後，再將提示詞送進該段接續的對話。這段提示詞會比照手動輸入的方式處理，因此會立刻顯示在畫面上、排在進行中的回合之後等待，並在傳送失敗時回報錯誤。
body.en: When you wanted to resume an old conversation with a remote agent and send an interactive prompt right away, the command combination previously failed to attach it to the same thread. Using `-i` (or `--prompt-interactive`) together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue` previously started a new conversation by mistake; now the tool waits for the history to finish loading before sending the prompt into that resumed conversation. The prompt is handled like typed input, so it appears on screen right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports an error if sending fails.

items.original: Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 平台指令引號、SSH 剪貼簿與排程提示問題
title.en: Fix Windows Command Quotes, SSH Clipboard, and Scheduled Prompt Issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上跑自動化、遠端連線複製內容或執行指令時，這三個容易卡關的毛病已經修好。

使用 `!` 執行指令時，PowerShell 不再吃掉雙引號，像 `! git commit -m "two words"` 會照原樣執行；離開 CLI 或在任務面板終止工作時，連帶啟動的程式也會一併結束，不會繼續留在背景執行，工作也不會繼續被標示為執行中。

透過 SSH 遠端連線使用 `/copy` 或其他剪貼簿功能時，複製的內容現在能順利送到你的本機剪貼簿，且不會再被寫進 CLI 的紀錄檔。

Windows 的排程自動化任務不再只讀到多行提示詞的第一行，現在無論是定時排程還是手動觸發執行，都會收到完整的多行提示詞。
body.en:
Three issues that used to trip up running automations, copying over remote connections, or executing commands on Windows are now fixed.

When running commands with `!`, PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed. Quitting the CLI or killing a task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs it started, so they no longer keep running in the background or leave the task marked as running.

When using `/copy` or other clipboard actions over SSH, the copied content now reaches your local clipboard and is no longer written to the CLI log file.

Scheduled automations on Windows no longer read only the first line of a multi-line prompt; both scheduled runs and manually triggered runs now receive the full multi-line prompt.

items.original:
Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.
Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.
Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 反覆彈出鑰匙圈找不到提示框的問題
title.en: Fix Recurring "Keychain Not Found" Dialog on macOS

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 上使用工具時，過去「Keychain Not Found」視窗大約每小時就會重新跳出一次。現在當鑰匙圈寫入失敗後，CLI 會在該工作階段的剩餘期間改把登入 token（用來驗證身分的授權令牌）存進檔案式儲存空間，不再於每次更新 token 時重複嘗試寫入鑰匙圈。
body.en: When using the tool on macOS, the "Keychain Not Found" dialog used to reappear about once an hour. Now, after a keychain write fails, the CLI saves your sign-in token (an authentication credential used to verify your identity) to file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.

items.original: Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 伺服器與外掛的啟動競爭及登入異常
title.en: Fix MCP Server and Plugin Startup Race and Sign-In Issues

body.zh-TW:
啟用多個外掛或外部工具並進行帳號驗證時，以下三項連線與登入問題已獲修復。

在多個子代理剛啟動之際重新載入 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，過去會因競爭狀態啟動重複的伺服器程序，導致部分子代理的 MCP 工具失效或登入失敗，現在已解決。

在沒有 IPv4 本機迴環位址的機器上進行 MCP 伺服器與外掛的 OAuth 登入時（例如僅支援 IPv6 的虛擬機），過去在 `127.0.0.1` 無法使用時會無聲失敗，現在登入回呼會改用 `[::1]` 作為備援。

從 `/plugin` 登入外掛時，即使登入剛完成，偶爾會錯誤回報登入尚未完成的問題也已修好。
body.en:
Three connection and sign-in issues when enabling multiple plugins or external tools and authenticating accounts are now fixed.

Reloading MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers while multiple subagents were starting up used to launch duplicate server processes due to a race condition, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins. That issue is now resolved.

When performing OAuth sign-in for MCP servers and plugins on machines without an IPv4 loopback address (such as IPv6-only VMs), sign-in used to fail silently when `127.0.0.1` was unavailable; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` instead.

Signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` also no longer occasionally reports that sign-in has not finished when it has just succeeded.

items.original:
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.
Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Ctrl+O 展開工具群組的排版與摘要顯示
title.en: Fix Layout and Summary Display When Expanding Tool Groups with Ctrl+O

body.zh-TW: 當你按 `Ctrl+O` 展開工具群組想看細節時，過去群組位置會跟著跳動。現在收合提示會與展開提示維持在同一行，而在低詳細度模式下，token（計費用的文字單位）摘要列也不會再從展開後的畫面消失。
body.en: When you press `Ctrl+O` to expand a tool group for details, the group position used to jump around. Now the collapse hint stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low-verbosity mode the token (the text unit used for billing) summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.

items.original: Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.

title.zh-TW: 修正手機版遠端控制網頁的模型選單捲動故障
title.en: Fix Model Selector Scrolling in the Mobile Remote Control Web View

body.zh-TW: 拿手機開啟遠端控制網頁想換模型時，過去手指滑動清單卻過不了第一屏，後面的選項怎麼樣都點不到。這個問題已經修好，現在可以觸控捲動超過第一屏，選取清單後段的模型。
body.en: When opening the Remote Control web view on a phone to switch models, swiping the list used to stop at the first screen, making options further down unreachable. This is now fixed, so you can touch-scroll past the first screen and select models near the end of the list.

items.original: Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

entries: Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen through an enterprise model gateway.

Added click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: clicking a tool group, a thought, a prompt's attached images, or multi-line command output now expands or collapses just that item, so you no longer have to use `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` is unchanged.

Added context window usage updates to `agy acp` sessions, so editors such as JetBrains AI Chat can show how much of the model's context window the conversation is using; the value is sent when a session starts or is reloaded, after each model call, and after a model or thinking level change.

Added support for two admin settings: `gateway.routeWebFetch` stops the agent's web page reads from going around an enterprise model gateway by disabling URL reading unless a `proxy.address` is configured, and `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` lets an organization turn off Remote Control. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (through `proxy.address` when set) instead of through Google's fetch service.

Improved the first message of a conversation in `--remote-agent` sessions, which no longer waits for its remote environment to start or resume: the CLI now prepares a new conversation's environment as soon as the session knows its remote project, and again after `/new` or switching projects, and starts a resumed conversation's idle environment in the background as soon as it opens with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`.

Fixed a security issue in the terminal sandbox's network proxy where a command could get around path-based network rules, such as those limiting where credentials are sent or which Git and API paths are allowed, by using percent-encoded slashes (`%2F`), backslashes, or `..` segments in a URL path; every way of reading the path is now checked against the rules, and the cleaned-up path is the one sent upstream.

Fixed always-allow command rules on Windows so they can no longer be bypassed when the shell is `cmd`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, or a full path to one of them. Commands run in PowerShell or Command Prompt now always need an exact match, because their quoting rules differ from POSIX shells. A command with hidden extra statements, such as `git status '&& del secret.txt'`, could otherwise be approved by a rule meant only for `git status`.

Fixed permission rules for MCP tools, such as an `mcp(server/tool)` deny or ask rule, being ignored for MCP tools that are loaded up front (marked eager in `mcp_config.json`) and for the `/browser` subagent's Chrome DevTools tools; these tools now ask for approval or are blocked according to your rules, like other MCP tools.

Fixed `/plugin`, `agy plugin`, and headless `-p` runs ignoring your organization's Gemini Enterprise admin controls for plugins: when an administrator disables plugins, installing, importing, or enabling one now fails with `plugins are disabled by your organization`, and when the plugin marketplace is disabled, marketplace catalogs are not fetched and marketplace installs fail; listing, disabling, and uninstalling plugins still work.

Fixed hook commands on Windows that contain double quotes, such as `type "C:\my dir\deny.json"`, failing and being silently skipped, which let a `PreInvocation` or `PreToolUse` hook that should block the agent go unenforced; hook commands are now passed to `cmd.exe` exactly as written.

Fixed files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as Windows PowerShell, Visual Studio, and Notepad's "UTF-8 with BOM" option do, being silently ignored: `settings.json` and files passed to `--settings` are no longer rejected as malformed, a `hooks.json` no longer leaves `/hooks` empty with none of its hooks running, and custom agent and rule files no longer go missing from `/agents` and the agent picker or lose their frontmatter trigger.

Fixed opening your external editor on Windows when `EDITOR` or the `Editor` setting is a normal Windows path such as `C:\Tools\ed.cmd` or `"C:\Program Files\Vim\vim.exe"`; backslashes were dropped, so `Ctrl+G`, `/open`, `/keybindings`, and artifact review failed with an `editor ... not found in PATH` error.

Fixed `!` shell commands hanging forever with no output when the command wrote a lot to stderr, which was easy to hit on Windows with build tools that print progress or warnings to stderr; such commands now finish and show their stdout and stderr lines in the order they were written.

Fixed agent turns failing when a network connection silently went stale or the network dropped a shared HTTP/2 connection, for example with `http2: client connection force closed via ClientConn.Close` or after a socket write error; model requests now retry on a fresh connection and, if retries run out, show the CLI's network error message. Slow model responses also no longer time out after 60 seconds when an organization's admin settings configure a proxy or custom CA certificate.

Fixed the CLI sometimes never exiting after a session, and background requests such as generating a conversation title, worktree name, or commit message hanging, when the model answered one of those requests with an unexpectedly long reply.

Fixed a single empty or corrupted queued message file, for example one left behind by an unclean shutdown, blocking every later message to the agent, so background task completions, timers, and subagent replies no longer silently stop reaching it; the unreadable file is set aside and the remaining messages are delivered.

Fixed remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth without a client secret signing you out as soon as the access token expired, typically after an hour; token refreshes now send the client ID the way the server requires, so you stay signed in, including with sign-ins saved by earlier versions.

Fixed the agent telling you to click a Sign in button or use an Accounts tab, which the CLI doesn't have, when a plugin or plugin MCP server needs you to sign in; it now tells you to sign in with `/plugin` and then send a message to continue, and `/mcp` shows the same `/plugin` guidance for a server that is waiting on a sign-in.
Fixed switching a conversation from a Gemini model to a custom or admin-managed non-Gemini model, such as Claude, failing with an `Invalid signature in thinking block` error.

Fixed `/btw` and `/help` side questions failing with `stream timed out after 5m0s` while the side question was still working: they now run until they finish or you press `Esc`, which the `Thinking...` line and the "already in progress" message now mention, and a side question that needs an approval the card can't show stops right away and tells you to ask in the main conversation instead.

Fixed `/learn` repeatedly appending to rule files such as `GEMINI.md` or `AGENTS.md` until they grew past the rule size limit, after which their endings were silently cut off on every turn. Before updating a rule, `/learn` now checks the documented size limits, and when an update would get close to or exceed them, it proposes condensing existing entries, splitting them into a scoped rule, or moving step-by-step guidance into a skill.

Fixed follow-up turns in a `--json-schema` conversation resumed with `--conversation` ending on a plain-text reply with no structured result once an earlier turn had produced one; each new message now gets its own reminders to return the structured output, up to the usual limit per message.
Fixed `/rewind` failing with a `step_index out of bounds` error when you pressed `Esc` while a turn was still starting and then rewound to remove that message.

Fixed `/diff` showing a made-up change at the end of a turn's diff for files larger than 500 KB when an earlier edit changed the file's length; the two versions are now cut off at the same line, so the preview shows only real edits.

Fixed `/` search in the artifact viewer missing text split across different styles, such as a sentence containing a number or inline code, and leaving the rest of a styled line unstyled after a highlighted match; the current match is also now easier to pick out from the other matches in every color scheme.

Fixed status messages such as "Copied 3 lines (42 characters)" after selecting text, settings save errors, and permission reload notices never appearing when you use a custom status line; they now briefly replace your custom status line, which comes back once the message clears, without shifting the layout.
Fixed the in-progress spinner line freezing until you restarted the CLI after you logged out while the agent was working and then signed back in; it now keeps animating.

title.zh-TW: /model 新增 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 與 Carbon 模型支援
title.en: /model Adds Support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Carbon Models

body.zh-TW: 當你想嘗試最新一代模型來處理日常任務時，現在可以直接切換到 Gemini 4 系列。⟦如同工具行進駐新一代動力機具，架上依照出力大小整齊陳列，只要憑會員卡或企業通行證就能隨時提領使用。⟧透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 連線時，`/model` 與 `--model` 迎來了 Gemini 4 Hydrogen（提供 Low、Medium、High 與 XHigh 四種思考強度）。選單也同步加入了 Gemini 4 Carbon（提供 Low、Medium 與 High 三種思考強度）。如果你習慣使用應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入，同樣可以使用這四種強度的 Hydrogen 模型。而在透過企業模型閘道連線的工作環境裡，也已經支援使用 Gemini 4 Hydrogen。
body.en: When you want to try the latest generation of models for everyday tasks, you can now switch straight to the Gemini 4 family. ⟦A hardware store stocks a new line of power tools, arranged neatly on the shelves by output size, ready to check out anytime with a membership card or corporate pass.⟧ When connecting with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `/model` and `--model` now include Gemini 4 Hydrogen (offering Low, Medium, High, and XHigh thinking levels). The menu also adds Gemini 4 Carbon (offering Low, Medium, and High thinking levels). If you prefer signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), you can use all four thinking levels of Hydrogen as well. Environments connecting through an enterprise model gateway also support Gemini 4 Hydrogen.

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) and Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`, added Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low, Medium, High, and XHigh) when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), and added support for Gemini 4 Hydrogen through an enterprise model gateway.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕渲染模式支援點擊展開，免按快速鍵收合單一區塊
title.en: Click to Expand Single Blocks in Full Screen Rendering Mode Without Shortcuts

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡閱讀長篇回應與工具記錄時，若想確認某段內容，翻找起來常需要反覆切換檢視。⟦就像閱讀互動式摺疊目錄一樣，以前想看細節必須按下開關整批掀開，現在只要用滑鼠輕點目標，就能單獨展開或收起該段落。⟧在全螢幕 `full screen (altscreen)` 渲染模式下，終端機介面新增了滑鼠點擊展開機制。現在只要點擊工具分組、思考過程、提示詞隨附的圖片，或是多行指令輸出，就能直接展開或摺疊特定項目。你不必再透過 `Ctrl+O` 鍵來回切換。預設的渲染模式（Rendering Mode）則維持原樣。
body.en: When reading long responses and tool logs in the terminal, checking a specific section often meant toggling views back and forth. ⟦Picture an interactive folding catalog where you previously had to flip a switch to open everything at once for details, whereas now a click on one target expands or collapses just that section.⟧ In the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, the terminal interface now supports click-to-expand. Clicking a tool group, a thought, images attached to a prompt, or multi-line command output now directly expands or collapses that specific item. You no longer need to toggle back and forth with `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` remains unchanged.

items.original: Added click-to-expand in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: clicking a tool group, a thought, a prompt's attached images, or multi-line command output now expands or collapses just that item, so you no longer have to use `Ctrl+O`. The default `Rendering Mode` is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 即時回報上下文用量，編輯器可顯示使用比例
title.en: agy acp Reports Context Usage in Real Time for Editor Indicators

body.zh-TW: 當你在外部編輯器裡調用助手時，常想掌握對話佔據了模型多少記憶容量。⟦類似儀表板即時顯示油量，車輛啟動、行駛加速或變更檔位時指針都會更新，駕駛隨時能掌握剩餘行駛額度。⟧在 `agy acp` 建立的工作階段中，現在會主動回報上下文視窗（模型單次能容納的文字量）的使用進度。這讓 JetBrains AI Chat 等外接編輯器能夠即時顯示對話佔用的比例。該數值會在工作階段剛啟動或重新載入時送出。每當模型完成一次呼叫，或是你切換模型與調整思考層級時，終端機也會立即推送最新用量。
body.en: When calling the assistant from an external editor, it helps to know how much of the model's memory capacity your conversation is taking up. ⟦Like a dashboard fuel gauge updating in real time, the needle moves when the car starts, accelerates, or shifts gears so the driver always knows the remaining range.⟧ Sessions created by `agy acp` now actively report usage progress for the context window (the amount of text a model can hold at once). This lets external editors such as JetBrains AI Chat display the conversation's usage ratio in real time. The value is sent when a session starts or reloads. Whenever a model call finishes, or when you switch models or adjust the thinking level, the CLI also pushes the latest usage immediately.

items.original: Added context window usage updates to `agy acp` sessions, so editors such as JetBrains AI Chat can show how much of the model's context window the conversation is using; the value is sent when a session starts or is reloaded, after each model call, and after a model or thinking level change.

title.zh-TW: 新增企業管理員設定，可嚴格控管網頁讀取與停用遠端操控
title.en: New Enterprise Admin Settings Restrict Web Reads and Disable Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 企業在落實資安合規政策時，常需要集中管理員工終端對外連線與遠端存取權限。⟦宛若大樓管委會為辦公室出入口設定門禁規範，既能關閉遠端遙控門鎖，也能強制所有包裹必須經由指定櫃檯轉交。⟧新增的 `gateway.routeWebFetch` 設定鍵可防止代理人讀取網頁時繞過企業模型閘道。除非額外配置了 `proxy.address`，否則會直接停用讀取網址的功能。在搭配企業模型閘道的情況下，網頁會改由你的電腦直接抓取（有配置時走 `proxy.address` 轉發），不再經過 Google 的抓取服務。另一項 `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` 則能讓組織停用遠端操控（Remote Control）功能。
body.en: When enforcing security compliance policies, enterprises often need centralized control over outbound terminal connections and remote access permissions. ⟦Think of a building management committee setting access rules for office entrances, able to disable remote-controlled locks while requiring every package to pass through a designated front desk.⟧ The new `gateway.routeWebFetch` setting prevents the agent from bypassing an enterprise model gateway when reading web pages. Unless `proxy.address` is also configured, URL reading is disabled outright. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (routed through `proxy.address` when configured) instead of through Google's fetch service. Another setting, `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled`, lets organizations turn off Remote Control.

items.original: Added support for two admin settings: `gateway.routeWebFetch` stops the agent's web page reads from going around an enterprise model gateway by disabling URL reading unless a `proxy.address` is configured, and `featureControls.remoteControlEnabled` lets an organization turn off Remote Control. With an enterprise model gateway, web pages are now fetched directly from your machine (through `proxy.address` when set) instead of through Google's fetch service.

title.zh-TW: --remote-agent 背景預先喚醒遠端環境，首則訊息零等待
title.en: --remote-agent Pre-Warms Remote Environments in the Background for Zero-Wait First Messages

body.zh-TW: 當你使用遠端代理人連線開發時，每次開啟對話往往要乾等遠端主機完成啟動。⟦猶如外勤駕駛在預約乘客抵達前就先暖好車輛，乘客一開門就能直接出發，不必坐在車內原地等待熱機。⟧在 `--remote-agent` 建立的工作階段中，送出首則訊息時不再需要停滯等待。只要確認了遠端專案，終端機就會立即在背景備妥新對話的執行環境。輸入 `/new` 或切換專案時也會再次提前準備。若透過 `--continue` 或 `--conversation=<id>` 恢復先前對話，閒置中的環境也會在對話開啟的瞬間於背景喚醒。
body.en: When developing with a remote agent connection, starting a conversation often meant waiting around for the remote host to boot up. ⟦A chauffeur warms up the car before the scheduled passenger arrives, so they can pull away the moment the door opens without sitting inside waiting for the engine.⟧ In sessions created with `--remote-agent`, sending the first message no longer stalls waiting. As soon as the remote project is known, the CLI prepares the new conversation's environment in the background right away. It prepares ahead again after `/new` or switching projects. When resuming an earlier conversation with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`, an idle environment also wakes up in the background the moment the conversation opens.

items.original: Improved the first message of a conversation in `--remote-agent` sessions, which no longer waits for its remote environment to start or resume: the CLI now prepares a new conversation's environment as soon as the session knows its remote project, and again after `/new` or switching projects, and starts a resumed conversation's idle environment in the background as soon as it opens with `--continue` or `--conversation=<id>`.

title.zh-TW: 修復多項權限與安全防護漏洞，阻斷繞過沙盒與指令白名單
title.en: Fix Permission and Security Gaps Blocking Sandbox and Allowlist Bypasses

body.zh-TW:
當你為代理人配置安全規則時，各層防護現在能確實阻截繞過行為。

終端機沙盒會檢查網址路徑的各種解析，阻擋 `%2F`、反斜線、`..` 繞過憑證與 API 限制，只傳送清理後的路徑。

Windows 的 `cmd`、`powershell` 指令須完全符合一律允許規則，夾帶額外陳述式不再放行。

預載 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具與 `/browser` 除錯工具會遵守拒絕或詢問規則。

`/plugin`、`agy plugin`、無頭模式（headless，無終端機畫面的執行模式）`-p` 均受組織管制：停用外掛後，安裝、匯入、啟用會報 `plugins are disabled by your organization`；停用市集則不抓目錄、不能從市集安裝。列出、停用、解除安裝仍可用。
body.en:
When you configure security rules for the agent, each layer of protection now reliably blocks bypass attempts.

The terminal sandbox checks every interpretation of a URL path, blocking `%2F`, backslashes, and `..` from bypassing credential and API restrictions, and sends only the cleaned-up path.

Windows `cmd` and `powershell` commands must now match always-allow rules exactly, so hidden extra statements are no longer permitted.

Eagerly loaded MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) tools and `/browser` DevTools now follow deny and ask rules.

`/plugin`, `agy plugin`, and headless (running without a terminal screen) `-p` runs all respect organization controls: when plugins are disabled, installing, importing, or enabling one fails with `plugins are disabled by your organization`; when the marketplace is disabled, catalogs are not fetched and marketplace installs fail. Listing, disabling, and uninstalling still work.

items.original:
Fixed a security issue in the terminal sandbox's network proxy where a command could get around path-based network rules, such as those limiting where credentials are sent or which Git and API paths are allowed, by using percent-encoded slashes (`%2F`), backslashes, or `..` segments in a URL path; every way of reading the path is now checked against the rules, and the cleaned-up path is the one sent upstream.
Fixed always-allow command rules on Windows so they can no longer be bypassed when the shell is `cmd`, `cmd.exe`, `powershell.exe`, `pwsh.exe`, or a full path to one of them. Commands run in PowerShell or Command Prompt now always need an exact match, because their quoting rules differ from POSIX shells. A command with hidden extra statements, such as `git status '&& del secret.txt'`, could otherwise be approved by a rule meant only for `git status`.
Fixed permission rules for MCP tools, such as an `mcp(server/tool)` deny or ask rule, being ignored for MCP tools that are loaded up front (marked eager in `mcp_config.json`) and for the `/browser` subagent's Chrome DevTools tools; these tools now ask for approval or are blocked according to your rules, like other MCP tools.
Fixed `/plugin`, `agy plugin`, and headless `-p` runs ignoring your organization's Gemini Enterprise admin controls for plugins: when an administrator disables plugins, installing, importing, or enabling one now fails with `plugins are disabled by your organization`, and when the plugin marketplace is disabled, marketplace catalogs are not fetched and marketplace installs fail; listing, disabling, and uninstalling plugins still work.

title.zh-TW: Windows 修正 UTF-8 BOM 讀取、路徑反斜線與掛鉤引號問題
title.en: Fix Windows UTF-8 BOM Reading, Path Backslashes, and Hook Quoting

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 環境下配置設定與執行腳本時，檔案編碼與指令呼叫的幾處問題已經修好。

掛鉤（hook，事件發生時觸發的小程式）含雙引號時不再被略過；`PreInvocation`、`PreToolUse` 攔截會生效，指令原樣傳給 `cmd.exe`。

UTF-8 BOM（檔案開頭的編碼標記）不再讓檔案被忽略。`settings.json`、`--settings` 指定檔案不再被誤判格式錯誤。`hooks.json` 的掛鉤會在 `/hooks` 正常顯示並執行。自訂代理人與規則檔不再從 `/agents`、代理人選單消失，或失去檔案開頭設定的觸發條件。

`EDITOR` 的 Windows 路徑不再掉落反斜線，`/open` 等功能能正常喚起編輯器。

以 `!` 執行的殼層指令大量寫入標準錯誤時不再卡死，會完整執行並按順序印出所有輸出。
body.en:
Several file encoding and command invocation issues when configuring settings and running scripts on Windows have been fixed.

Hooks (small programs triggered when events occur) containing double quotes are no longer skipped; `PreInvocation` and `PreToolUse` blocks take effect, and commands are passed to `cmd.exe` as written.

A UTF-8 BOM (an encoding marker at the start of a file) no longer causes files to be ignored. `settings.json` and files passed to `--settings` are no longer rejected as malformed. Hooks in `hooks.json` appear in `/hooks` and run normally. Custom agent and rule files no longer disappear from `/agents` and the agent picker, or lose their frontmatter triggers.

Windows paths in `EDITOR` no longer drop backslashes, so features like `/open` launch the editor properly.

Shell commands run with `!` no longer hang when writing heavily to stderr; they finish completely and print all output in order.

items.original:
Fixed hook commands on Windows that contain double quotes, such as `type "C:\my dir\deny.json"`, failing and being silently skipped, which let a `PreInvocation` or `PreToolUse` hook that should block the agent go unenforced; hook commands are now passed to `cmd.exe` exactly as written.
Fixed files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM), as Windows PowerShell, Visual Studio, and Notepad's "UTF-8 with BOM" option do, being silently ignored: `settings.json` and files passed to `--settings` are no longer rejected as malformed, a `hooks.json` no longer leaves `/hooks` empty with none of its hooks running, and custom agent and rule files no longer go missing from `/agents` and the agent picker or lose their frontmatter trigger.
Fixed opening your external editor on Windows when `EDITOR` or the `Editor` setting is a normal Windows path such as `C:\Tools\ed.cmd` or `"C:\Program Files\Vim\vim.exe"`; backslashes were dropped, so `Ctrl+G`, `/open`, `/keybindings`, and artifact review failed with an `editor ... not found in PATH` error.
Fixed `!` shell commands hanging forever with no output when the command wrote a lot to stderr, which was easy to hit on Windows with build tools that print progress or warnings to stderr; such commands now finish and show their stdout and stderr lines in the order they were written.

title.zh-TW: 修復網路斷線重試機制，排解背景任務與訊息佇列卡死
title.en: Fix Network Disconnect Retries and Resolve Background Task and Queue Hangs

body.zh-TW:
當網路環境不穩或長時間執行任務時，斷線會以新連線重試，背景阻塞的幾處問題也已修好。

代理人對話遇到連線失效或 HTTP/2 中斷，模型請求會用新連線重試；次數耗盡仍會顯示終端機的網路錯誤。組織管理員設定代理伺服器或自訂 CA 憑證（用來確認連線對象可信的證明）時，緩慢回應不再於 60 秒後強制逾時。

產生對話標題、工作樹（worktree，平行開啟專案副本的功能）名稱或提交訊息等背景請求時，模型若回傳非預期的超長文字，先前會卡死請求，或使工作階段結束後無法退出；現在已修好。

排程佇列中因異常關閉留下的空白或損壞檔案，不再阻擋後續通知、計時器與次代理人回覆；無法讀取的檔案會被隔離，其餘訊息正常遞送。

代理人運作期間若登出再重新登入，進度旋轉指示條不再凍結停擺，會持續正常旋轉。
body.en:
When network conditions are unstable or tasks run for a long time, dropped connections now retry on a fresh connection, and several background stalls are resolved.

When an agent turn hits a stale connection or an HTTP/2 drop, model requests retry on a new connection; if retries run out, the CLI still shows its network error. Slow responses no longer force a timeout after 60 seconds when an organization admin configures a proxy or custom CA certificate (a credential that verifies a connection target is trusted).

Background requests such as generating a conversation title, worktree (a feature for opening parallel copies of a project) name, or commit message previously hung or prevented exiting after a session when the model returned an unexpectedly long reply; this is now fixed.

Empty or corrupted files left in the message queue by an unclean shutdown no longer block later notifications, timers, or subagent replies; unreadable files are set aside and the remaining messages are delivered.

Logging out and back in while the agent is working no longer freezes the progress spinner; it keeps animating normally.

items.original:
Fixed agent turns failing when a network connection silently went stale or the network dropped a shared HTTP/2 connection, for example with `http2: client connection force closed via ClientConn.Close` or after a socket write error; model requests now retry on a fresh connection and, if retries run out, show the CLI's network error message. Slow model responses also no longer time out after 60 seconds when an organization's admin settings configure a proxy or custom CA certificate.
Fixed the CLI sometimes never exiting after a session, and background requests such as generating a conversation title, worktree name, or commit message hanging, when the model answered one of those requests with an unexpectedly long reply.
Fixed a single empty or corrupted queued message file, for example one left behind by an unclean shutdown, blocking every later message to the agent, so background task completions, timers, and subagent replies no longer silently stop reaching it; the unreadable file is set aside and the remaining messages are delivered.
Fixed the in-progress spinner line freezing until you restarted the CLI after you logged out while the agent was working and then signed back in; it now keeps animating.

title.zh-TW: 修復遠端 MCP 權杖更新、外掛登入提示與模型切換簽章錯誤
title.en: Fix Remote MCP Token Refreshes, Plugin Sign-In Prompts, and Model Switch Signature Errors

body.zh-TW:
當你整合外部擴充服務或切換不同模型時，驗證交握與操作提示的幾處中斷狀況已經排除。

遠端 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若使用無需密鑰的 OAuth 登入，先前會在憑證過期後立即被登出。通常一小時後 token（授權令牌）失效連線就中斷；現在更新權杖時會依規範送出客戶端識別碼，舊版儲存的登入也一併保持連線。

當外掛或其 MCP 伺服器需要認證時，代理人先前會叫你點擊介面上不存在的登入按鈕。現在會正確引導你透過 `/plugin` 登入並發送訊息繼續，`/mcp` 也會顯示一致的指引。

將現有對話從 Gemini 模型切換至自訂或管理員管理的非 Gemini 模型，例如 Claude 時，先前會出現思考區塊簽章錯誤（`Invalid signature in thinking block`），該問題已順利排除。
body.en:
Several handshake and prompt interruptions when integrating external services or switching models have been resolved.

Remote MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) servers using OAuth sign-in without a client secret previously signed you out as soon as credentials expired. Typically after an hour, the access token (an authorization credential) expired and the connection dropped; token refreshes now send the client ID as required, keeping sign-ins saved by earlier versions connected as well.

When a plugin or its MCP server required authentication, the agent previously told you to click a non-existent Sign in button. It now properly guides you to sign in via `/plugin` and send a message to continue, and `/mcp` shows the same guidance.

Switching an existing conversation from a Gemini model to a custom or admin-managed non-Gemini model such as Claude previously failed with an `Invalid signature in thinking block` error, which is now resolved.

items.original:
Fixed remote MCP servers that sign in with OAuth without a client secret signing you out as soon as the access token expired, typically after an hour; token refreshes now send the client ID the way the server requires, so you stay signed in, including with sign-ins saved by earlier versions.
Fixed the agent telling you to click a Sign in button or use an Accounts tab, which the CLI doesn't have, when a plugin or plugin MCP server needs you to sign in; it now tells you to sign in with `/plugin` and then send a message to continue, and `/mcp` shows the same `/plugin` guidance for a server that is waiting on a sign-in.
Fixed switching a conversation from a Gemini model to a custom or admin-managed non-Gemini model, such as Claude, failing with an `Invalid signature in thinking block` error.

title.zh-TW: /learn 新增規則大小上限檢查，避免指令重複追加導致內容被截斷
title.en: /learn Adds Rule Size Limit Checks to Prevent Silent Truncation from Repeated Appends

body.zh-TW: 當你經常使用 `/learn` 指令教導代理人個人工作偏好時，持續累積的規則可能不知不覺超過限制。⟦好比隨身便條本頁數有限，寫滿前就先提醒你整理重點、把舊筆記分類歸檔，而不是任由後面的文字直接被頁尾裁掉。⟧先前 `/learn` 會重複向 `GEMINI.md` 或 `AGENTS.md` 等檔案追加內容，直到超出規則容量上限，導致末端條目在每輪對話中被悄悄截斷。現在更新規則前會主動比對大小限制；當長度接近或超標時，終端機會提議精簡現有條目、拆分出特定範圍的規則，或是將逐步操作引導改寫成技能（skill）。
body.en: When you regularly use `/learn` to teach the agent your workflow preferences, accumulated rules can quietly grow past their limits. ⟦Just like a pocket notepad with limited pages, it reminds you to condense key points and file old notes by category before running out of space, rather than letting later text get cut off at the bottom.⟧ Previously, `/learn` kept appending to files like `GEMINI.md` or `AGENTS.md` until they exceeded the rule size limit, causing trailing entries to be silently cut off on every turn. Now it checks size limits before updating a rule; when an update gets close to or exceeds them, the CLI proposes condensing existing entries, splitting them into a scoped rule, or turning step-by-step guidance into a skill.

items.original: Fixed `/learn` repeatedly appending to rule files such as `GEMINI.md` or `AGENTS.md` until they grew past the rule size limit, after which their endings were silently cut off on every turn. Before updating a rule, `/learn` now checks the documented size limits, and when an update would get close to or exceed them, it proposes condensing existing entries, splitting them into a scoped rule, or moving step-by-step guidance into a skill.

title.zh-TW: 修復 /btw 旁支提問逾時、結構化輸出提醒與 /rewind 倒帶錯誤
title.en: Fix /btw side-question timeouts, structured output reminders, and /rewind errors

body.zh-TW:
在對話過程中穿插側邊提問、結構化回應或回退歷史時，幾處流程中斷的瑕疵已經修好。

用 `/btw`、`/help` 發問，先前超過 5 分鐘會報 `stream timed out after 5m0s`。現在會執行到完成或你按 `Esc`；`Thinking...` 與 `already in progress` 提示也會說明。若需要卡片無法顯示的權限核准，會立即中止並提示改到主對話詢問。

透過 `--conversation` 恢復以 `--json-schema` 啟動的對話時，先前輪次若已給出結構化結果，後續提問容易退回純文字。現在每則新訊息各有結構化輸出提醒，仍受每則訊息通常的提醒次數上限約束。

在回合剛開始時按 `Esc` 並隨即用 `/rewind` 撤回訊息，先前會出現 `step_index out of bounds` 錯誤而無法撤回；現在已修好。
body.en:
Several workflow interruptions when asking side questions, requesting structured responses, or rewinding history during a conversation have been fixed.

Asking with `/btw` or `/help` previously failed with `stream timed out after 5m0s` after 5 minutes. They now run until completion or until you press `Esc`, which the `Thinking...` and `already in progress` notices also mention. If a side question needs a permission approval the card cannot show, it stops immediately and prompts you to ask in the main conversation instead.

When resuming a conversation started with `--json-schema` via `--conversation`, follow-up questions tended to fall back to plain text if an earlier turn had already produced a structured result. Each new message now gets its own structured output reminders, still subject to the usual reminder limit per message.

Pressing `Esc` right as a turn started and immediately using `/rewind` to remove the message previously threw a `step_index out of bounds` error and failed to rewind; this is now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/btw` and `/help` side questions failing with `stream timed out after 5m0s` while the side question was still working: they now run until they finish or you press `Esc`, which the `Thinking...` line and the "already in progress" message now mention, and a side question that needs an approval the card can't show stops right away and tells you to ask in the main conversation instead.
Fixed follow-up turns in a `--json-schema` conversation resumed with `--conversation` ending on a plain-text reply with no structured result once an earlier turn had produced one; each new message now gets its own reminders to return the structured output, up to the usual limit per message.
Fixed `/rewind` failing with a `step_index out of bounds` error when you pressed `Esc` while a turn was still starting and then rewound to remove that message.

title.zh-TW: 修復 /diff 大檔比對虛構變更、產物搜尋斷詞與自訂狀態列通知
title.en: Fix /diff fabricated changes on large files, artifact search breaks, and custom statusLine notices

body.zh-TW:
當你比對程式變更、搜尋產物內容或自訂終端介面時，畫面顯示的多處瑕疵已經修正。

針對大於 500 KB 的檔案執行 `/diff` 檢視時，若先前的編輯更動了檔案長度，結尾處先前會出現憑空捏造的虛構變更。現在兩份版本會截斷在相同行數，確保只呈現真正的修改。

產物檢視器的 `/` 搜尋先前會漏掉跨樣式的文字（例如包含數字或行內程式碼），且比對反白後會讓同行其餘樣式消失；現在各色彩主題下當前比對項目的標記都清楚易讀。

使用自訂狀態列（statusLine，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）時，複製文字提示、儲存失敗或權限重載訊息先前完全不會顯示。現在這些通知會短暫替換狀態列並在關閉後復原，且不造成畫面位移。
body.en:
Several display glitches when diffing code changes, searching artifact contents, or customizing the terminal interface have been fixed.

When inspecting files larger than 500 KB with `/diff`, fabricated changes previously appeared at the end if an earlier edit had changed the file's length. Both versions are now truncated at the same line count so only real edits are shown.

The `/` search in the artifact viewer previously missed text spanning across styles (such as text containing numbers or inline code), and highlighting a match stripped the remaining styles on that line; the active match marker is now clearly legible in every color scheme.

When using a custom statusLine (the bar shown at the bottom of the terminal), copy notices, save failures, and permission reload messages previously never appeared. These notifications now briefly replace the bar and restore it once dismissed without shifting the layout.

items.original:
Fixed `/diff` showing a made-up change at the end of a turn's diff for files larger than 500 KB when an earlier edit changed the file's length; the two versions are now cut off at the same line, so the preview shows only real edits.
Fixed `/` search in the artifact viewer missing text split across different styles, such as a sentence containing a number or inline code, and leaving the rest of a styled line unstyled after a highlighted match; the current match is also now easier to pick out from the other matches in every color scheme.
Fixed status messages such as "Copied 3 lines (42 characters)" after selecting text, settings save errors, and permission reload notices never appearing when you use a custom status line; they now briefly replace your custom status line, which comes back once the message clears, without shifting the layout.

entries: Changed the default `Agent Mode` from Default to Auto: sessions with no saved mode, including headless `-p` runs, now start in Auto wherever Auto mode is available and in Default elsewhere; to keep the previous behavior, choose Default for `Agent Mode` in `/config`, which saves `"agentMode": ""` to `settings.json`. A `Tool Permission` setting of `strict` now also takes precedence over Auto and accept-edits modes, so file edits still ask for approval under `strict`.

Fixed multi-second UI freezes, which also stalled streaming and window resizing, when a command printed a very long line without spaces; line wrapping now takes time proportional to the line's length.
Fixed agent replies stalling for 20 seconds or more while a group of tool calls with long output was still animating its token counts; streamed steps now keep appearing while the group re-renders.

Fixed the agent not noticing that a command it moved to the background was waiting for input, such as a password or `y/n` prompt printed before the command went to the background; the agent is now notified once that output settles instead of waiting silently.

Fixed browser sign-in on Windows sometimes failing to complete because the CLI's local sign-in callback listened on only IPv4 or IPv6 while the browser redirected over the other; the callback now listens on both.

Fixed Gemini 4 Carbon requests through an enterprise model gateway failing with an HTTP 400 `Thinking budget is not supported for this model` error; the CLI now sends Gemini 4 Carbon a thinking level and no longer leaves the Low, Medium, or High suffix in the model ID it sends to the gateway.

Fixed a `PreToolUse` hook returning `auto_approve`, or a wildcard `command(*)` allow rule, bypassing an organization's admin-enforced review: commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, commands the admin policy holds for review, and file reads or writes outside the workspace under an "always ask" file-access policy now always ask for your approval.

Fixed saved command allow and deny rules being ignored, so that every command asked for approval, when an organization's admin policy requires commands to run in the terminal sandbox but the machine has no OS sandbox; your saved rules now apply and unlisted commands still ask before running.
Fixed background task details from `manage_task` losing their formatting when the task's recent output, or input sent to the task, contained Markdown code blocks or runs of backticks.
Fixed Remote Control showing a link that could not be opened at the end of some agent replies, such as the swarm coordinator's link to the swarm UI; Remote Control now leaves these links out.

title.zh-TW: 代理人預設改為自動模式，嚴格權限優先守護檔案修改
title.en: Agent defaults to Auto mode while strict permissions protect file edits

body.zh-TW:
打開終端機請代理人處理工作時，若你還沒儲存過模式設定，啟動方式就會受這次調整影響。尚未儲存模式的工作階段，包含使用 `-p` 參數的無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式），只要環境支援 `Auto` 就會預設自動啟動，其餘則維持 `Default`。⟦相機以前開機預設選一般模式，現在支援自動模式的機型會預設選自動模式，其餘仍選一般模式；改的是開機時先選哪個模式。⟧若想維持過去習慣，可在 `/config` 將 `Agent Mode` 選為 `Default`，設定會儲存到 `settings.json`：

```json
{
  "agentMode": ""
}
```

另外，`Tool Permission` 的 `strict` 嚴格權限優先於 `Auto` 與 `accept-edits` 模式，修改檔案前依然會主動詢問並等待你同意。
body.en:
When you open the terminal to ask the agent to handle work, if you have not saved a mode setting yet, how it starts is affected by this change. Sessions with no saved mode, including headless mode (an execution mode without a terminal screen) using the `-p` flag, now start in `Auto` by default wherever `Auto` is supported, while the rest stay in `Default`. ⟦A camera used to select normal mode by default at startup, and now models that support auto mode select auto mode by default while the rest still select normal mode; what changed is which mode is selected at power-on.⟧ To keep the previous behavior, you can set `Agent Mode` to `Default` in `/config`, which saves the setting to `settings.json`:

```json
{
  "agentMode": ""
}
```

In addition, `strict` under `Tool Permission` takes precedence over `Auto` and `accept-edits` modes, so it still asks and waits for your approval before editing files.

items.original: Changed the default `Agent Mode` from Default to Auto: sessions with no saved mode, including headless `-p` runs, now start in Auto wherever Auto mode is available and in Default elsewhere; to keep the previous behavior, choose Default for `Agent Mode` in `/config`, which saves `"agentMode": ""` to `settings.json`. A `Tool Permission` setting of `strict` now also takes precedence over Auto and accept-edits modes, so file edits still ask for approval under `strict`.

title.zh-TW: 終端機長行折行不再卡住，工具群組重繪時步驟持續顯示
title.en: Terminal line wrapping stops freezing and steps keep streaming during tool group redraws

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行會印出大量記錄的指令或呼叫工具時，畫面有時會突然整面卡住。以前如果某個指令印出一整行完全沒有空格的超長字串，會直接引發數秒的介面凍結，連帶讓文字串流與視窗縮放跟著動彈不得。現在文字折行所花費的時間會與該行長度成正比，不再長時間卡死。另外，當一組輸出很長的工具呼叫正在以動畫跳動顯示記號（token，AI 處理文字的計算單位）數量時，代理人的回覆以前會停頓 20 秒以上。現在該工具群組重新繪製時，後續串流的執行步驟依然會持續顯示。以前遇到無空格長文字或工具輸出動畫會卡死畫面，現在介面縮放與步驟串流都能即時反應。
body.en: When running commands that print large logs or calling tools in the terminal, the screen could sometimes freeze all at once. Previously, if a command printed a very long line with no spaces at all, it triggered multi-second UI freezes that also stalled text streaming and window resizing. Line wrapping now takes time proportional to the line's length instead of locking up for seconds. Also, while a group of tool calls with long output was animating its token (the unit AI uses to process text) counts, agent replies used to stall for 20 seconds or more. Now, streamed execution steps continue to appear while that tool group re-renders. Where long spaceless text or tool output animations used to freeze the screen, window resizing and step streaming now respond immediately.

items.original:
Fixed multi-second UI freezes, which also stalled streaming and window resizing, when a command printed a very long line without spaces; line wrapping now takes time proportional to the line's length.
Fixed agent replies stalling for 20 seconds or more while a group of tool calls with long output was still animating its token counts; streamed steps now keep appearing while the group re-renders.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令等待密碼或確認提示時，代理人主動接收通知
title.en: Agent receives notifications when background commands wait for passwords or prompts

body.zh-TW: 交辦代理人跑耗時較長的工作時，你可能遇過整個流程突然無聲卡住。以前當移至背景的指令正在等待輸入，例如指令轉入背景前印出密碼或 `y/n` 確認提示，代理人不會察覺並只會靜默等待。現在只要輸出內容穩定下來，代理人就會收到通知，不再無聲乾等。現在輸出穩定下來後，代理人會收到等待輸入的通知，不再無聲乾等。
body.en: When you ask the agent to run a long-running task, you may have seen the whole process suddenly stall in silence. Previously, when a command moved to the background was waiting for input, such as a password or `y/n` confirmation prompt printed before going to the background, the agent did not notice and just waited silently. Now, once the output settles, the agent receives a notification instead of waiting silently. Once the output settles, the agent is now notified that input is needed rather than waiting in silence.

items.original: Fixed the agent not noticing that a command it moved to the background was waiting for input, such as a password or `y/n` prompt printed before the command went to the background; the agent is now notified once that output settles instead of waiting silently.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版瀏覽器登入同時支援 IPv4 與 IPv6 回傳
title.en: Windows browser sign-in supports both IPv4 and IPv6 callbacks

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統透過瀏覽器進行帳號登入時，偶爾會碰上網頁跳轉後終端機卻沒有反應的狀況。以前指令列工具的本機登入回呼只監聽 IPv4 或 IPv6 其中一種協定，若瀏覽器透過另一種協定重新導向，登入就無法順利完成。現在本機回呼會同時監聽這兩種協定。以前登入容易因為網路協定不一致而卡在驗證畫面，現在瀏覽器重新導向後便能正常完成登入流程。
body.en: When signing in through a browser on Windows, the terminal would occasionally not respond after the web page redirected. Previously, the CLI's local sign-in callback listened on only IPv4 or IPv6, so if the browser redirected over the other protocol, sign-in could not complete. Now, the local callback listens on both protocols. Sign-in used to get stuck on the verification screen due to protocol mismatches, and now it completes normally after the browser redirects.

items.original: Fixed browser sign-in on Windows sometimes failing to complete because the CLI's local sign-in callback listened on only IPv4 or IPv6 while the browser redirected over the other; the callback now listens on both.

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道請求 Gemini 4 Carbon 調整參數，排除 HTTP 400 錯誤
title.en: Enterprise gateway requests to Gemini 4 Carbon adjust parameters to prevent HTTP 400 errors

body.zh-TW: 當你在企業環境透過模型閘道使用 Gemini 4 Carbon 時，發送請求可能曾遇到連線失敗。以前請求會跳出 HTTP 400 錯誤，提示 `Thinking budget is not supported for this model`。現在指令列工具會改向 Gemini 4 Carbon 發送思考層級（thinking level），發給閘道的模型識別碼也不再殘留 Low、Medium 或 High 後綴。以前發送請求會被閘道直接退回，現在格式修正後便能正常呼叫。
body.en: When using Gemini 4 Carbon through a model gateway in an enterprise environment, your requests may have failed to connect. Previously, requests returned an HTTP 400 error with the message `Thinking budget is not supported for this model`. Now, the CLI sends a thinking level to Gemini 4 Carbon instead, and the model ID sent to the gateway no longer retains a Low, Medium, or High suffix. Requests that used to be rejected directly by the gateway now succeed with the corrected format.

items.original: Fixed Gemini 4 Carbon requests through an enterprise model gateway failing with an HTTP 400 `Thinking budget is not supported for this model` error; the CLI now sends Gemini 4 Carbon a thinking level and no longer leaves the Low, Medium, or High suffix in the model ID it sends to the gateway.

title.zh-TW: 企業安全政策強化審核機制，並恢復無系統沙盒時的自訂規則
title.en: Enterprise security policies tighten review checks and restore custom rules without an OS sandbox

body.zh-TW: 在受組織管理政策管制的環境下執行指令或存取檔案時，審核機制迎來了兩項修正。以前若設定了回傳 `auto_approve` 的 `PreToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），或使用 `command(*)` 萬用允許規則，會意外略過管理員強制要求的審查。現在跳脫終端機沙盒的指令、管理員政策保留審查的指令，以及「一律詢問」政策下讀寫工作區外的操作，一律會向你要求確認。當組織政策要求在終端機沙盒內執行指令，但電腦缺少系統沙盒時，以前會忽略已儲存的允許與拒絕規則，導致每條指令都反覆跳出確認。現在儲存的允許與拒絕規則會正常套用，未列出的指令執行前仍會詢問。以前容易因規則漏洞略過公司審核，或在缺少系統沙盒時被繁瑣提示打擾，現在審查嚴謹且自訂名單正常生效。
body.en: When running commands or accessing files under organization-managed policies, two fixes have been made to the review mechanism. Previously, a `PreToolUse` hook (a small program triggered by specific events) returning `auto_approve`, or a wildcard `command(*)` allow rule, could accidentally bypass admin-enforced reviews. Now, commands that leave the terminal sandbox, commands held for review by admin policy, and file reads or writes outside the workspace under an "always ask" policy always ask for your approval. When an organization policy requires commands to run inside a terminal sandbox but the machine lacks an OS sandbox, saved allow and deny rules used to be ignored, causing every command to prompt repeatedly. Now, saved allow and deny rules apply normally, while unlisted commands still ask before running. Instead of rule gaps bypassing company reviews or missing OS sandboxes triggering repetitive prompts, reviews are now enforced and custom lists work as expected.

items.original:
Fixed a `PreToolUse` hook returning `auto_approve`, or a wildcard `command(*)` allow rule, bypassing an organization's admin-enforced review: commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, commands the admin policy holds for review, and file reads or writes outside the workspace under an "always ask" file-access policy now always ask for your approval.
Fixed saved command allow and deny rules being ignored, so that every command asked for approval, when an organization's admin policy requires commands to run in the terminal sandbox but the machine has no OS sandbox; your saved rules now apply and unlisted commands still ask before running.

title.zh-TW: 檢視背景任務詳情時，保留程式碼區塊與反引號格式
title.en: Background task details preserve code blocks and backtick formatting

body.zh-TW: 當你透過 `manage_task` 工具查看背景任務的執行狀態時，文字排版可能曾出現錯亂。以前如果任務近期的輸出內容，或是傳送給任務的輸入包含 Markdown 程式碼區塊或連續反引號，任務詳情的排版格式會跑版損毀。這個問題現在已經修好，相關內容會完整保留原有排版。以前閱讀包含程式碼的任務資訊容易版面混亂，現在都能維持工整外觀。
body.en: When checking a background task's status with the `manage_task` tool, the text formatting may have been garbled. Previously, if the task's recent output or input sent to the task contained Markdown code blocks or runs of backticks, the task details formatting broke. This issue is now fixed, and the content preserves its original formatting. Where reading task details with code used to look messy, everything now stays cleanly formatted.

items.original: Fixed background task details from `manage_task` losing their formatting when the task's recent output, or input sent to the task, contained Markdown code blocks or runs of backticks.

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控介面隱藏無效連結，不再顯示無法開啟的網址
title.en: Remote Control hides broken links instead of showing unopenable URLs

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端操控（Remote Control）功能查看代理人回覆時，結尾可能曾出現點不開的連結。以前在部分回覆末端，例如多代理人群組協調員（swarm coordinator）連往群組介面的連結，遠端操控會顯示無法開啟的網址。現在遠端操控會直接略過這些連結。以前在遠端介面常看見無法點擊的網址，現在遠端操控會略過這些無法開啟的連結。
body.en: When viewing agent replies with Remote Control, unclickable links could sometimes appear at the end. Previously, at the end of some replies, such as a swarm coordinator's link to the swarm UI, Remote Control showed URLs that could not be opened. Remote Control now omits these links. Where unclickable URLs used to show up in the remote interface, Remote Control now skips these unopenable links.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control showing a link that could not be opened at the end of some agent replies, such as the swarm coordinator's link to the swarm UI; Remote Control now leaves these links out.

entries: Added the swarm's queen bee to the `/swarm board` header and a 🐝 beside each live member in the `Roster`; in terminals with Kitty graphics, such as Kitty and Ghostty, each member gets its own colored bee card that flaps while that member is working, and other terminals, including tmux, show the queen as pixel art when the window is at least 60×35.

Added a `continuation_active` field to the JSON input of Stop hooks, which is `true` while the agent is already working on a continuation an earlier Stop hook requested, so a hook such as "run the tests before finishing" can tell it has already asked and avoid looping.

Added a `supportsThoughtCirculation` option to admin-managed model entries (`models.list[]` in admin settings), so organizations can let non-Gemini models behind an enterprise model gateway reuse their reasoning from earlier turns; when it is unset, the model's default applies.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it asks less often on safe reads: GitHub API reads, fetches into an existing clone, and single-file downloads such as `raw.githubusercontent.com` URLs no longer get the repository popularity, age, and release checks that cloning a repository still gets, host names that start with a digit are no longer mistaken for IP addresses, and reading `~/.ssh/config`, `known_hosts`, `authorized_keys`, or public keys (`*.pub`) is no longer treated as reading secrets, while private keys still are and sending any `.ssh` file elsewhere is still blocked.

Improved `agy plugin validate` to warn when a plugin hook command uses `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` or `$PLUGIN_ROOT`, which older CLI versions do not set, and to suggest a relative path instead, since hooks already run in the plugin's folder; the warning fails validation only with `--strict`.

Changed pay-as-you-go Google Cloud accounts that sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) to use the same permission settings as other pay-as-you-go accounts, which makes Auto mode available to them; Gemini Enterprise accounts keep following their organization's admin-controlled permission settings, including their `unsandboxed(...)` deny and ask rules, and are not offered Auto mode.
Fixed undo and redo in the prompt, including `u` in Vim mode, moving the cursor to the end of the input; the cursor now returns to where the undone or redone edit was made.

Fixed `agy plugin install` ignoring the skill folders that a Claude Code plugin lists in the `"skills"` field of its manifest; those skills are now installed and loaded, and the install summary warns about listed paths that are missing, contain no skill, or point outside the plugin.

Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` leaving a half-copied plugin that still loaded as enabled when an install failed partway; installs are now swapped in all at once and the previous version is restored on failure, plugins containing symlinks that point outside the plugin, FIFOs, or device files are refused, and a command whose file name cannot be used as a skill folder name is skipped with a warning instead of failing the import.

Fixed pressing `esc` in a swarm member's conversation opened from `/swarm board` with `o` dropping you back at the prompt; it now returns to the board with the same selection, filter, focused pane, and zoom.

Fixed a swarm coordinator sometimes ending its turn with a one-line filler reply instead of its real answer after being sent back to re-read board posts it had already read, fixed a coordinator offering a `sidecar://` board link that the CLI cannot open instead of `/swarm board` on later turns of a swarm, and fixed `agy -p` runs that start a swarm pointing you to `/swarm board`, which headless runs cannot open.

Fixed some models served through an enterprise model gateway being sent requests without native tool declarations, which kept the agent from calling tools reliably; every model in the gateway's catalog, including models listed in `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_MODELS`, now gets native tool calls.

Fixed custom Gemini models served through an enterprise model gateway or an admin model list, such as tuned models, cutting off long edits and file writes at 8,192 output tokens; they now default to the same 65,535-token output limit as built-in Gemini models, and an explicit admin `maxOutputTokens` value still takes precedence.

Fixed duplicate approval prompts and sandbox errors for organizations that enforce sandbox mode on machines without an OS sandbox, such as some Windows hosts or Linux with user namespaces disabled; commands now ask for review once and then run.

Fixed editing project rules with `/permissions` clearing the marker that records the project's permission rules as already migrated, which made the Antigravity app migrate them again and could drop `command(...)` allow rules when the sandbox is on.

title.zh-TW: 蜂群儀表板加入蜂王與動態蜂卡，終端機即時呈現分工狀態
title.en: Swarm Dashboard Adds Queen Bee and Animated Cards for Real-Time Status in Terminal

body.zh-TW: 你在終端機使用蜂群模式讓多位代理人協同解決問題時，常需要確認每位成員到底是在待命中還是忙碌運作。輸入 `/swarm board` 開啟儀表板，頂端標頭現在新增了蜂王標誌，成員名冊（`Roster`）裡的每位在線成員旁也都會標上 🐝 符號。⟦就像看體育賽事的分組計分板一樣，以前名牌只有靜態文字，誰在場上跑動得逐行確認；現在看板頂端直接掛上代表隊長的標誌，正在跑動的隊員卡片還會動態拍翅，視窗夠大的黑白螢幕也會呈現像素點陣圖。⟧如果你的終端機支援 Kitty 圖像協定（例如 Kitty 或 Ghostty），每位成員都會顯示一張專屬的彩色小蜂卡，只要該成員正在處理工作，卡片上的小蜜蜂就會拍動翅膀。在 tmux 等其他終端機中，只要視窗大小達到 60×35 以上，標頭也會以像素畫呈現蜂王。
body.en: When using swarm mode in the terminal to collaborate with multiple agents on solving problems, you often need to check whether each member is on standby or actively working. Opening the dashboard with `/swarm board`, the header now adds a queen bee emblem, and each live member in the roster (`Roster`) is marked with a 🐝 symbol. ⟦Picture a sports tournament scoreboard: rosters previously showed only static text and required checking line by line to see who was active on the field, whereas the board now mounts a captain emblem at the top, active team members' cards dynamically flap their wings, and sufficiently large monochrome screens render pixel art.⟧ In terminals supporting the Kitty graphics protocol, such as Kitty and Ghostty, each member displays a dedicated colored bee card that flaps its wings whenever that member is working. In other terminals including tmux, the header also renders the queen as pixel art whenever the window size is at least 60×35.

items.original: Added the swarm's queen bee to the `/swarm board` header and a 🐝 beside each live member in the `Roster`; in terminals with Kitty graphics, such as Kitty and Ghostty, each member gets its own colored bee card that flaps while that member is working, and other terminals, including tmux, show the queen as pixel art when the window is at least 60×35.

title.zh-TW: 停止掛鉤新增延續狀態欄位，避免測試檢查陷入無限迴圈
