title.en: Stop Hooks Add Continuation State Field to Prevent Test Checks from Looping Infinitely

body.zh-TW: 當你替代理人設定了自訂的自動化檢查，要求它在結束任務前必須先跑完測試時，很容易因為重複觸發而卡在同一個環節。現在停止掛鉤（Stop hook，在準備結束任務時觸發的小程式）的 JSON 輸入中，新增了名為 `continuation_active` 的布林值欄位。⟦跟出差報帳的審核單一樣，以前審核員每次看到單據就要求補齊發票，代理人補件後再次送審又被同一條規定攔下；現在單據上蓋有處理中的戳記，審核員確認已在跑流程就不會重複退件。⟧當代理人已經在處理先前停止掛鉤所要求的延續任務時，這個欄位會標記為 `true`。這樣一來，像是「收尾前先跑測試」這類掛鉤就能直接辨識出自己先前已經提出過請求，不會在代理人跑完測試準備收工時再次發動攔截，徹底避免了無窮迴圈。
body.en: When you configure custom automated checks for an agent requiring it to run tests before finishing a task, repeated triggers can easily get it stuck in the same step. The JSON input of Stop hooks (small programs triggered when preparing to finish a task) now includes a boolean field named `continuation_active`. ⟦Think of an expense reimbursement approval sheet: auditors previously demanded missing receipts every time they saw a form, stopping the agent again under the exact same rule after supplements were submitted; now the sheet is stamped as in-progress, so auditors confirm the workflow is already underway and avoid repeated rejections.⟧ This field is marked as `true` while the agent is already working on a continuation requested by an earlier Stop hook. As a result, hooks such as "run the tests before finishing" can directly recognize that they have already made the request and avoid intercepting again when the agent finishes tests and prepares to wrap up, completely preventing infinite loops.

items.original: Added a `continuation_active` field to the JSON input of Stop hooks, which is `true` while the agent is already working on a continuation an earlier Stop hook requested, so a hook such as "run the tests before finishing" can tell it has already asked and avoid looping.

title.zh-TW: 企業模型閘道支援推理複用，原生工具呼叫與長文字輸出更穩
title.en: Enterprise Model Gateway Supports Reasoning Reuse with Reliable Native Tool Calls and Long Output

body.zh-TW:
在企業環境中透過私有閘道串接外部模型時，管理員常需要確保自訂模型能順利呼叫工具並完整輸出長文字。

管理員設定中的模型清單（`models.list[]`）新增了 `supportsThoughtCirculation` 選項，讓閘道背後的非 Gemini 模型可複用先前輪次的推理內容，未設定時維持預設。

過去部分透過閘道提供的模型缺少原生工具宣告，導致無法可靠呼叫工具。現在閘道目錄中的所有模型，包含環境變數 `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_MODELS` 列出的項目，都會帶上原生工具宣告。

自訂 Gemini 模型過去輸出會在 8,192 個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）處截斷。現在預設放寬為與內建模型相同的 65,535 個上限，若明確指定 `maxOutputTokens` 則優先採用。
body.en:
When connecting external models through a private gateway in enterprise environments, administrators often need to ensure custom models invoke tools reliably and output long texts completely.

The model list in admin settings (`models.list[]`) adds a `supportsThoughtCirculation` option so organizations can let non-Gemini models behind an enterprise model gateway reuse reasoning from earlier turns, keeping the model default when unset.

Previously, some models served through an enterprise model gateway lacked native tool declarations, preventing the agent from calling tools reliably. Every model in the gateway catalog, including items listed in the environment variable `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_MODELS`, now carries native tool declarations.

Custom Gemini models previously cut off output at 8,192 tokens (text units for AI processing and billing). They now default to the same 65,535-token limit as built-in models, with an explicitly specified `maxOutputTokens` still taking precedence.

items.original:
Added a `supportsThoughtCirculation` option to admin-managed model entries (`models.list[]` in admin settings), so organizations can let non-Gemini models behind an enterprise model gateway reuse their reasoning from earlier turns; when it is unset, the model's default applies.
Fixed some models served through an enterprise model gateway being sent requests without native tool declarations, which kept the agent from calling tools reliably; every model in the gateway's catalog, including models listed in `AGY_LLM_GATEWAY_MODELS`, now gets native tool calls.
Fixed custom Gemini models served through an enterprise model gateway or an admin model list, such as tuned models, cutting off long edits and file writes at 8,192 output tokens; they now default to the same 65,535-token output limit as built-in Gemini models, and an explicit admin `maxOutputTokens` value still takes precedence.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式放寬安全讀取審查，查詢公開資料與公鑰不再反覆確認
title.en: Auto Mode Relaxes Safe Read Reviews to Eliminate Repeated Prompts for Public Data and Keys

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Auto 模式讓代理人自動跑指令時，若指令需要離開終端機沙盒，常會因為嚴苛的審查機制而頻繁跳出確認。⟦好比圖書館閱覽室的安檢關卡，以前讀者翻閱架上的公開報刊或出示借書證，都要被當作調閱珍本檔案逐次簽核；現在公開資料與名片快速放行，只有私人借閱卡與外帶藏書依舊維持嚴格查驗。⟧現在安全讀取顯著減少打擾：讀取 GitHub API、向既有複本拉取進度或下載 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 等單檔，不再檢查儲存庫熱門度、年齡與發布狀態，但完整複製時依然保留。數字開頭的主機名稱不再被誤判為 IP 位址。讀取 `~/.ssh/config`、`known_hosts`、`authorized_keys` 或公鑰（`*.pub`）不再視為機密，但私鑰依舊防護，傳送任何 `.ssh` 檔案至外部仍一律阻擋。
body.en: When you enable Auto mode to let the agent run commands automatically, commands needing to leave the terminal sandbox often trigger frequent confirmation prompts due to strict review mechanisms. ⟦Consider a security checkpoint in a library reading room: readers browsing open periodicals on shelves or showing library passes previously faced item-by-item sign-offs as if requesting rare archival records, but now public data and name cards are cleared quickly while private borrowing cards and book checkouts still undergo strict inspection.⟧ Safe reads now significantly reduce interruptions: reading the GitHub API, fetching updates into an existing clone, or downloading single files such as `raw.githubusercontent.com` URLs no longer triggers repository popularity, age, or release checks, though full cloning still retains them. Host names starting with a digit are no longer misidentified as IP addresses. Reading `~/.ssh/config`, `known_hosts`, `authorized_keys`, or public keys (`*.pub`) is no longer treated as reading secrets, while private keys remain protected and sending any `.ssh` file externally is still blocked across the board.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it asks less often on safe reads: GitHub API reads, fetches into an existing clone, and single-file downloads such as `raw.githubusercontent.com` URLs no longer get the repository popularity, age, and release checks that cloning a repository still gets, host names that start with a digit are no longer mistaken for IP addresses, and reading `~/.ssh/config`, `known_hosts`, `authorized_keys`, or public keys (`*.pub`) is no longer treated as reading secrets, while private keys still are and sending any `.ssh` file elsewhere is still blocked.

title.zh-TW: 外掛管理健全驗證與安裝交易機制，完整載入技能並阻擋危險檔案
title.en: Plugin Management Hardens Validation and Atomic Installs to Load Skills Completely and Block Unsafe Files

body.zh-TW:
開發或安裝第三方外掛時，路徑配置不當或安裝中斷常會導致功能缺失或殘留損壞檔案。

執行 `agy plugin validate` 時，若掛鉤（特定事件觸發的小程式）指令使用舊版未設定的 `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` 或 `$PLUGIN_ROOT`，會警告並建議改用相對路徑，僅在 `--strict` 時判為失敗。

執行 `agy plugin install` 現在會安裝並載入 Claude Code 外掛在 `"skills"` 欄位宣告的技能資料夾，若路徑遺失、無技能或指向外部則在摘要警告。

安裝與 `agy plugin import` 匯入改採一次切換，失敗會還原舊版，並拒絕含指向外部的符號連結（指向外掛外的捷徑檔）、FIFO 或裝置檔的外掛。若指令檔名無法當成技能目錄名則以警告略過，不再中斷匯入。
body.en:
When developing or installing third-party plugins, improper path configurations or interrupted installations often cause missing features or leftover damaged files.

Running `agy plugin validate` now warns and suggests using relative paths when a hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) command uses `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` or `$PLUGIN_ROOT` unset in older versions, failing validation only under `--strict`.

Running `agy plugin install` now installs and loads skill folders declared in the `"skills"` field of Claude Code plugins, warning in the install summary about listed paths that are missing, contain no skills, or point outside the plugin.

Installs and imports via `agy plugin import` now switch files all at once, restoring the previous version on failure and refusing plugins containing FIFOs, device files, or symlinks pointing outside the plugin (shortcut files pointing outside the plugin). If a command filename cannot be used as a skill folder name, it is skipped with a warning instead of aborting the import.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` to warn when a plugin hook command uses `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` or `$PLUGIN_ROOT`, which older CLI versions do not set, and to suggest a relative path instead, since hooks already run in the plugin's folder; the warning fails validation only with `--strict`.
Fixed `agy plugin install` ignoring the skill folders that a Claude Code plugin lists in the `"skills"` field of its manifest; those skills are now installed and loaded, and the install summary warns about listed paths that are missing, contain no skill, or point outside the plugin.
Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` leaving a half-copied plugin that still loaded as enabled when an install failed partway; installs are now swapped in all at once and the previous version is restored on failure, plugins containing symlinks that point outside the plugin, FIFOs, or device files are refused, and a command whose file name cannot be used as a skill folder name is skipped with a warning instead of failing the import.

title.zh-TW: 憑證帳號支援 Auto 模式，修正無沙盒系統重複審批與權限重置
title.en: Credential Accounts Support Auto Mode While Fixing Sandbox Reprompts and Permission Resets

body.zh-TW:
當你在團隊環境中設定專案權限或使用特定憑證登入時，常會受限於帳號分類或因為環境相容性而遭遇重複提示。

透過應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入的 Google Cloud 按量帳號已比照一般按量帳號開放 Auto 模式。Gemini Enterprise 帳號則維持管理員設定，包含 `unsandboxed(...)` 拒絕與詢問規則，不提供 Auto 模式。

若在缺乏原生沙盒的環境（例如 Windows 主機或停用使用者命名空間的 Linux）強制開啟沙盒，過去會重複提示與報錯，現在指令經審核一次即可執行。

修正使用 `/permissions` 編輯專案規則時會清除遷移標記的錯誤，避免應用程式重複遷移並在開啟沙盒時遺失 `command(...)` 允許規則。
body.en:
When configuring project permissions in team environments or signing in with specific credentials, users are often restricted by account tiers or encounter duplicate prompts due to environment compatibility.

Pay-as-you-go Google Cloud accounts signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) now have Auto mode available on par with standard pay-as-you-go accounts. Gemini Enterprise accounts keep following admin-controlled settings, including their `unsandboxed(...)` deny and ask rules, and are not offered Auto mode.

If sandbox mode is enforced in environments lacking an OS sandbox, such as Windows hosts or Linux with user namespaces disabled, commands previously triggered duplicate approval prompts and sandbox errors but now run after asking for review once.

Fixed an issue where editing project rules with `/permissions` cleared the marker recording permission rules as already migrated, preventing the app from migrating them again and dropping `command(...)` allow rules when the sandbox is enabled.

items.original:
Changed pay-as-you-go Google Cloud accounts that sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) to use the same permission settings as other pay-as-you-go accounts, which makes Auto mode available to them; Gemini Enterprise accounts keep following their organization's admin-controlled permission settings, including their `unsandboxed(...)` deny and ask rules, and are not offered Auto mode.
Fixed duplicate approval prompts and sandbox errors for organizations that enforce sandbox mode on machines without an OS sandbox, such as some Windows hosts or Linux with user namespaces disabled; commands now ask for review once and then run.
Fixed editing project rules with `/permissions` clearing the marker that records the project's permission rules as already migrated, which made the Antigravity app migrate them again and could drop `command(...)` allow rules when the sandbox is on.

title.zh-TW: 復原與重做操作正確保留游標，不再跳至輸入列末端
title.en: Undo and Redo Preserve Cursor Position Instead of Jumping to Input End

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入較長的提示詞時，如果打錯字想要復原修改，游標的停留位置會直接影響編輯節奏。以前在輸入列中執行復原或重做，包含在 Vim 模式下按下 `u` 鍵，游標都會不由分說地直接跳到整串輸入內容的最末端，害你必須手動按鍵移回修改處。現在這個問題已經修好，游標在復原或重做後會正確回到剛才進行編輯的位置。
body.en: When entering longer prompts in the terminal, where the cursor lands after undoing typos directly impacts editing flow. Previously, performing undo or redo in the input prompt—including pressing `u` in Vim mode—inevitably jumped the cursor straight to the very end of the input string, forcing you to manually navigate back to the edited spot. This issue has now been fixed, and the cursor correctly returns to where the undone or redone edit was made.

items.original: Fixed undo and redo in the prompt, including `u` in Vim mode, moving the cursor to the end of the input; the cursor now returns to where the undone or redone edit was made.

title.zh-TW: 修復蜂群面板跳離問題，並校正協同主控回覆與連線連結
title.en: Fixed Swarm Board Exits and Corrected Coordinator Replies and Board Links

body.zh-TW:
在蜂群模式中穿梭於儀表板與個別成員的對話紀錄時，操作順暢度與主控代理人的回覆品質息息相關。

過去從 `/swarm board` 儀表板按下 `o` 鍵開啟成員對話後，按下 `esc` 鍵會直接掉出面板並回到終端機提示字元。現在按下 `esc` 會正確返回儀表板，並完整保留你先前的選取項目、篩選條件、焦點窗格與縮放比例。

在協同主控（coordinator）方面，過去被退回重讀已讀過的留言時，有時會回傳單行敷衍語句而非真實回答，這項錯誤已經修好。主控在後續輪次也不再提供命令列打不開的 `sidecar://` 連結，而是正確引導使用 `/swarm board`。同時，以 `agy -p` 在無頭模式（headless，沒有視覺介面的執行模式）啟動蜂群時，也不會再指向無頭環境無法開啟的儀表板。
body.en:
When navigating between the dashboard and individual member conversations in swarm mode, operational smoothness and coordinator reply quality are closely linked.

Previously, pressing `esc` in a swarm member's conversation opened from `/swarm board` with `o` dropped you back at the terminal prompt. Pressing `esc` now correctly returns to the board, preserving your previous selection, filter, focused pane, and zoom.

For the coordinator, an issue where being sent back to re-read board posts it had already read sometimes produced a one-line filler reply instead of a real answer has been fixed. The coordinator also no longer offers `sidecar://` board links that the CLI cannot open instead of `/swarm board` on later turns. Additionally, runs with `agy -p` that start a swarm in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) will no longer point to the dashboard, which cannot be opened in a headless environment.

items.original:
Fixed pressing `esc` in a swarm member's conversation opened from `/swarm board` with `o` dropping you back at the prompt; it now returns to the board with the same selection, filter, focused pane, and zoom.
Fixed a swarm coordinator sometimes ending its turn with a one-line filler reply instead of its real answer after being sent back to re-read board posts it had already read, fixed a coordinator offering a `sidecar://` board link that the CLI cannot open instead of `/swarm board` on later turns of a swarm, and fixed `agy -p` runs that start a swarm pointing you to `/swarm board`, which headless runs cannot open.

entries: Added swarms as a preview: start one with `/swarm <task>` and the agent becomes a coordinator that adds worker agents, each in its own conversation, which work on the task in parallel and collaborate through a shared message board; workers can be forked from an existing member's conversation, run on any model in the `/model` picker, and pause instead of retrying when their model runs out of quota, and a monitor worker alerts the coordinator when the whole swarm stalls. `/swarm` is labeled `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the `/` menu because every worker is a separate agent that uses your quota.

Added `/swarm board`, a full-screen live view of the current swarm that also opens with `alt+s` (rebindable as `swarm.board`), with a `Roster` of members showing each one's state and model, a `Posts` feed, and a `Message` pane that renders the selected post as Markdown; `tab` and `shift+tab` move between panes, `z` zooms the focused pane, `enter` shows or hides the message, `[` and `]` step through posts, `p` filters the feed to one member's posts and the posts that mention them, `o` opens a member's subagent details, `f` follows new posts, and `esc` backs out.

Added a `● Swarm(<title>)` row to the active-items tray below the prompt while a swarm runs, showing the latest post and the post count and then `Done` when the swarm finishes; press `Enter` on the row to open `/swarm board`, or `alt+x` (`swarm.dismiss`) to dismiss it.

Added the `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP` environment variable, which you can set to `true` to stop the CLI from extracting and running its bundled `ripgrep`, for example when endpoint security software blocks it, so searches use a `ripgrep` on your `PATH` or the built-in search instead.
Added Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).

Changed enterprise model gateway URLs to require `https://` unless the gateway runs on the same machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`); a remote gateway configured with a plain `http://` URL is now rejected with an error instead of receiving your prompts unencrypted.

Fixed `agy plugin import` turning Claude Code plugin commands into skills that did not load or were all named `SKILL`; each command now becomes a skill named after its folder, including commands with no frontmatter or with Claude Code-style values such as `argument-hint: [base branch] [focus]`, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about the leftover `commands/` folder.

Fixed `agy plugin import` copying certain plugin's `hooks/hooks.json` unchanged, which caused the plugin's hooks to be skipped; `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, and startup `SessionStart` hooks are now converted, with tool names in matchers mapped to built-in tools (for example `Bash` to `run_command`) and a default 60-second timeout, and hooks with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the import summary.

Fixed `agy -p` headless runs sometimes never exiting after printing their result when a background task, such as conversation title generation, got stuck; the CLI now finishes shutting down within 30 seconds.

Fixed `/teamwork` writing run state into `.agents/teamwork/` in your working directory, where two runs in the same workspace could overwrite each other; each run now keeps its state in its own folder under the CLI's app data directory.

Fixed links to files in agent responses showing only the file name, which made the file's location impossible to tell in terminals that cannot open clickable links, such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH; labels now show the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path.
Fixed enterprise model gateways that validate the request format rejecting every request, because the CLI sent a non-standard `sessionId` field in Gemini-format requests.

Fixed subagents and swarm workers that get their own copy of a Git repository starting from the last commit and losing your uncommitted work; their worktree now includes your staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, and agents outside version control can give a subagent or worker an isolated copy of the workspace folder, for folders up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB.

title.zh-TW: /swarm 預覽版支援多代理人協作，透過共享看板分工推進任務
title.en: Preview /swarm supports multi-agent collaboration to advance tasks through a shared board

body.zh-TW: 面對大型架構重構或跨模組調查時，只靠單一對話往往得排隊等待 AI 一步步執行。現在輸入 `/swarm <任務>` 就能開啟預覽版蜂群模式。主要代理人會轉為協調員，在各自獨立的工作階段中加入多位工作代理人，彼此透過共享留言板平行處理工作。工作代理人可以從既有成員的對話衍生分支，並自由選用 `/model` 選單裡的任何模型。遇到模型額度用盡時，工作代理人會暫停作業而非持續重試。要是整組蜂群陷入停擺，監控代理人會主動向協調員發出警示。由於每位工作代理人都是獨立運作並消耗額度，因此斜線選單上特別標記為 `(Preview & Quota Heavy)`。⟦跟研發專案指派多組小組分頭調查一樣，以前一人卡關進度就中斷；現在各組在公佈欄留言同步情報，碰上材料短缺先原地待命，監工發現全線停工也會通報主持主管。⟧
body.en: When facing large architecture refactors or cross-module investigations, relying on a single conversation often means waiting in line as the AI executes step by step. You can now enter `/swarm <task>` to launch the preview swarm mode. The primary agent becomes a coordinator that adds multiple worker agents, each in its own independent session, working on tasks in parallel through a shared message board. Worker agents can be forked from an existing member's conversation and freely use any model from the `/model` picker. When a model runs out of quota, worker agents pause instead of repeatedly retrying. If the entire swarm stalls, a monitor agent alerts the coordinator. Because each worker agent operates independently and consumes quota, it is specifically marked as `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the slash menu. ⟦Just as an R&D project assigns multiple teams to investigate separately, previously progress halted whenever one person got stuck; now each team syncs updates on a bulletin board, stays on standby when materials run low, and an overseer alerts the lead manager if all work stalls.⟧

items.original: Added swarms as a preview: start one with `/swarm <task>` and the agent becomes a coordinator that adds worker agents, each in its own conversation, which work on the task in parallel and collaborate through a shared message board; workers can be forked from an existing member's conversation, run on any model in the `/model` picker, and pause instead of retrying when their model runs out of quota, and a monitor worker alerts the coordinator when the whole swarm stalls. `/swarm` is labeled `(Preview & Quota Heavy)` in the `/` menu because every worker is a separate agent that uses your quota.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕看板與狀態列掌握 Swarm 進度，支援快捷鍵即時監控
title.en: Track Swarm progress with full-screen board and status row, featuring shortcut keys for live monitoring

body.zh-TW:
當背景有多位代理人同時運作時，隨時掌握各成員的發言與進展至關重要。蜂群運作期間，輸入框下方的作用中項目系統匣會顯示 `● Swarm(<標題>)` 列，即時呈現最新留言與發文總數，完成時標記為 `Done`。你可以在該列按 `Enter` 開啟 `/swarm board` 全螢幕看板，或按 `alt+x` 關閉提示列（可自訂為 `swarm.dismiss`）。平常也能隨時按 `alt+s` 叫出看板（可自訂為 `swarm.board`）。看板分為成員名單（呈現各成員狀態與模型）、貼文牆與 Markdown 預覽窗格，並支援完整導覽按鍵：

```
tab / shift+tab # 在各窗格間切換
z               # 放大目前聚焦的窗格
enter           # 展開或隱藏選取的訊息
[ / ]           # 上下逐篇瀏覽貼文
p               # 篩選特定成員的貼文與標記提及
o               # 開啟成員的子代理人詳細資訊
f               # 自動跟隨最新發布的貼文
esc             # 返回前一個畫面
```

⟦好比戰情室監控多組外勤任務，以前只能盯著終端機逐行盲猜動態；現在主螢幕分割呈現人員狀態與通報細節，手邊儀表板也能快速展開追蹤。⟧
body.en:
When multiple agents run simultaneously in the background, keeping track of every member's updates and progress is essential. While a swarm runs, a `● Swarm(<title>)` row appears in the active-items tray below the prompt, displaying the latest message and total post count, and marking `Done` when finished. You can press `Enter` on that row to open the `/swarm board` full-screen board, or press `alt+x` to dismiss the row (rebindable as `swarm.dismiss`). You can also press `alt+s` at any time to bring up the board (rebindable as `swarm.board`). The board is divided into a roster (showing each member's state and model), a posts feed, and a Markdown preview pane, supporting full navigation keys:

```
tab / shift+tab # Move between panes
z               # Zoom the focused pane
enter           # Show or hide the selected message
[ / ]           # Step up and down through posts
p               # Filter posts to a specific member and mentions
o               # Open a member's subagent details
f               # Follow new posts automatically
esc             # Back out to the previous screen
```

⟦Picture a situation room monitoring multiple field missions: operators once stared at terminal lines blindly guessing what was happening; now a split screen displays personnel status alongside report details, and a handy dashboard opens quickly for tracking.⟧

Added `/swarm board`, a full-screen live view of the current swarm that also opens with `alt+s` (rebindable as `swarm.board`), with a `Roster` of members showing each one's state and model, a `Posts` feed, and a `Message` pane that renders the selected post as Markdown; `tab` and `shift+tab` move between panes, `z` zooms the focused pane, `enter` shows or hides the message, `[` and `]` step through posts, `p` filters the feed to one member's posts and the posts that mention them, `o` opens a member's subagent details, `f` follows new posts, and `esc` backs out.

title.zh-TW: 新增環境變數停用內建 ripgrep，避開端點防護軟體攔截
title.en: Add environment variable to disable bundled ripgrep and avoid endpoint protection blocks

body.zh-TW: 在受企業資安管控的電腦上搜尋程式碼時，防毒軟體常會把工具臨時解壓縮出來的執行檔當成威脅阻擋。環境變數現在新增了 `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP`。只要將它設為 `true`，指令列工具就不會再解壓縮並執行隨附的 `ripgrep` 搜尋工具。這項設定專為終端安全防護軟體阻擋內建工具的情境設計。啟用後，搜尋流程會改用系統環境變數 `PATH` 中已安裝的 `ripgrep`，或是直接使用內建搜尋機制。⟦宛如攜帶專用工具組進入管制廠區，以前保全會扣留臨時拆封的隨身器具導致作業中斷；現在允許直接登記使用廠內合格的常駐設備，不用再強行解封。⟧
body.en: When searching code on machines subject to corporate security policies, antivirus software often blocks temporary executables extracted by tools as threats. A new environment variable, `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP`, is now available. Setting it to `true` stops the command-line tool from extracting and executing the bundled `ripgrep` search utility. This setting is specifically designed for situations where endpoint security software blocks embedded tools. Once enabled, searches use a `ripgrep` installed on your system `PATH` or fall back to the built-in search mechanism. ⟦Think of bringing a specialized toolkit into a restricted facility: security once confiscated newly unpacked personal gear and halted operations; now technicians may check out pre-approved resident equipment instead of unsealing fresh tools.⟧

items.original: Added the `ANTIGRAVITY_DISABLE_EMBEDDED_RIPGREP` environment variable, which you can set to `true` to stop the CLI from extracting and running its bundled `ripgrep`, for example when endpoint security software blocks it, so searches use a `ripgrep` on your `PATH` or the built-in search instead.

title.zh-TW: 支援應用程式預設憑證使用 Gemini 4 Carbon，提供 Low、Medium、High 三個版本
title.en: Support Gemini 4 Carbon via Application Default Credentials across Low, Medium, and High tiers

body.zh-TW: 如果你用 Google Cloud 憑證登入開發環境，想換個模型試試，現在多了新選擇。只要透過應用程式預設憑證（`AGY_ADC_AUTH`）登入，`/model` 選單與啟動參數 `--model` 都會出現 Gemini 4 Carbon，並提供 Low、Medium、High 三個版本。想指定其中一個，就在選單裡挑，或在啟動時加上 `--model` 並帶入對應的版本名稱。⟦就像專業維修廠的工具櫃裡多放了三把規格不同的扳手，以前走這條憑證通道只能用原本那幾把；現在多了三個選項可選，想用哪一把自己決定。⟧
body.en: If you sign in to your development environment with Google Cloud credentials and want to try another model, you now have a new option. When signing in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`), Gemini 4 Carbon appears in both the `/model` picker and the `--model` startup parameter across Low, Medium, and High tiers. To specify one, select it from the menu or pass `--model` with the corresponding tier name at launch. ⟦A professional repair shop adds three wrenches of different sizes to its tool cabinet: previously, accessing the cabinet through this credential channel offered only the original tools; now three extra options are available, letting technicians choose whichever fits.⟧

items.original: Added Gemini 4 Carbon (Low, Medium, and High) to `/model` and `--model` when you sign in with Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`).

title.zh-TW: 企業模型閘道強制加密連線，並修復 Gemini 格式請求欄位
title.en: Enforce encrypted connections for enterprise model gateways and fix Gemini request fields

body.zh-TW: 企業內部通常會架設專屬閘道轉發 AI 請求，以落實資料治理並稽核傳輸內容。設定遠端企業模型閘道網址時，現在一律強制使用 `https://` 加密連線。除非閘道位在同一台主機上（例如 `localhost`、`127.0.0.0/8` 或 `::1`），否則若設定為未加密的 `http://` 網址，工具會直接拒絕並回報錯誤，不再以明文送出提示詞。過去向企業閘道發送 Gemini 格式的請求時，工具會附帶非標準的 `sessionId` 欄位，導致嚴格檢查格式的閘道拒絕所有請求。這個格式問題已經修好。⟦如同企業內部設置機密公文傳送管道，以前允許明信片平信投遞且封條格式不符會被退回；現在遠端傳送一律強制密封掛號，信件代碼也改用標準規範封存。⟧
body.en: Enterprises commonly set up dedicated gateways to forward AI requests to enforce data governance and audit transmitted content. When configuring a remote enterprise model gateway URL, the CLI now strictly requires an encrypted `https://` connection. Unless the gateway runs on the same machine (such as `localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`), configuring an unencrypted `http://` URL is rejected with an error rather than sending prompts in plain text. In the past, sending Gemini-format requests to enterprise gateways included a non-standard `sessionId` field, causing gateways that strictly validate request formats to reject every request. This formatting issue has been fixed. ⟦Consider a secure courier dispatch system for sensitive documents: unsealed postcards were once permitted and irregular envelope stamps caused outright rejections; now remote dispatches mandate sealed certified mail while letter codes follow standard specifications.⟧

items.original:
Changed enterprise model gateway URLs to require `https://` unless the gateway runs on the same machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.0/8`, or `::1`); a remote gateway configured with a plain `http://` URL is now rejected with an error instead of receiving your prompts unencrypted.
Fixed enterprise model gateways that validate the request format rejecting every request, because the CLI sent a non-standard `sessionId` field in Gemini-format requests.

title.zh-TW: 匯入 Claude Code 外掛自動轉換指令與掛鉤，補齊相容對應
title.en: Import Claude Code plugins with automatic command and hook conversion for full compatibility

body.zh-TW: 搬移 Claude Code 外掛時，指令與掛鉤格式常因環境不同而無法載入。以前執行 `agy plugin import` 會把指令轉成無法載入或全名為 `SKILL` 的技能。現在每個指令都會以所在資料夾命名，`agy plugin validate` 也不再對殘留的 `commands/` 目錄警告。過去直接複製 `hooks/hooks.json`，會使掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）遭到略過。現在轉換時會將工具名稱對應為內建工具並套用 60 秒逾時，無對應項目則於摘要列出警告。⟦猶如更換轉接頭，以前規格不合會整批失效；現在自動將舊接腳轉換為標準插孔，無法對應的線路也會標註警示。⟧
body.en: When migrating Claude Code plugins, command and hook formats often fail to load due to environment differences. Previously, running `agy plugin import` converted commands into skills that failed to load or were all named `SKILL`. Now each command is named after its folder, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about leftover `commands/` directories. Previously, copying `hooks/hooks.json` directly caused hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) to be skipped. During conversion, tool names are now mapped to built-in tools with a 60-second timeout applied, while items with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the summary. ⟦Like fitting a replacement adapter: mismatched pins previously caused the entire setup to fail; now legacy pins automatically convert into standard sockets, and unmapped lines are flagged with clear warnings.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `agy plugin import` turning Claude Code plugin commands into skills that did not load or were all named `SKILL`; each command now becomes a skill named after its folder, including commands with no frontmatter or with Claude Code-style values such as `argument-hint: [base branch] [focus]`, and `agy plugin validate` no longer warns about the leftover `commands/` folder.
Fixed `agy plugin import` copying certain plugin's `hooks/hooks.json` unchanged, which caused the plugin's hooks to be skipped; `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, and startup `SessionStart` hooks are now converted, with tool names in matchers mapped to built-in tools (for example `Bash` to `run_command`) and a default 60-second timeout, and hooks with no equivalent are listed as warnings in the import summary.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式執行結束自動關閉，逾時 30 秒強制退出
title.en: Headless mode automatically shuts down after execution and forces exit on 30-second timeout

body.zh-TW: 在自動化腳本中以無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）呼叫工具時，若背景工作卡住常會導致整個排程停滯。以前使用 `agy -p` 跑完任務印出結果後，若遇上對話標題產生等背景工作卡死，程式有時永遠不會結束退出。現在工具會在 30 秒內完成關閉程序。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When invoking the CLI in headless mode (an execution mode without a visual interface) within automation scripts, stuck background tasks often halt the entire schedule. Previously, after completing a task and printing results with `agy -p`, the program sometimes never exited if a background task such as conversation title generation got stuck. The CLI now finishes its shutdown procedure within 30 seconds. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed `agy -p` headless runs sometimes never exiting after printing their result when a background task, such as conversation title generation, got stuck; the CLI now finishes shutting down within 30 seconds.

title.zh-TW: /teamwork 執行狀態改存應用程式資料夾，避免同目錄相互覆寫
title.en: Store /teamwork run state in app data directory to prevent mutual overwrites

body.zh-TW: 在同一個專案目錄下平行啟動多組團隊協作時，狀態檔案混用容易引發衝突。以前執行 `/teamwork` 會把狀態寫入工作目錄下的 `.agents/teamwork/` 資料夾，若在同一個工作區同時執行兩次，彼此的狀態就會互相覆寫。現在每次執行都會在工具的應用程式資料目錄下建立獨立資料夾存放狀態。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When launching multiple team collaborations in parallel under the same project directory, mixing state files can easily trigger conflicts. Previously, running `/teamwork` wrote run state into the `.agents/teamwork/` folder in your working directory, causing two runs in the same workspace to overwrite each other. Each run now stores its state in an isolated folder under the CLI's app data directory. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed `/teamwork` writing run state into `.agents/teamwork/` in your working directory, where two runs in the same workspace could overwrite each other; each run now keeps its state in its own folder under the CLI's app data directory.

title.zh-TW: 終端機檔案連結改列完整相對路徑，無點擊支援也能辨識位置
title.en: Terminal file links display relative paths to identify locations without clickable support

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 連線或在傳統終端機中工作時，畫面往往無法直接點擊開啟超連結。以前代理人回覆檔案連結時只顯示檔名，在無法點擊連結的終端機（例如 Terminal.app、`screen` 或 SSH 連線）中無法辨識檔案位置。現在標籤會明確顯示相對於工作目錄的路徑、相對於 `~/` 的路徑或絕對路徑。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When working over SSH connections or in traditional terminals, screens often cannot directly open clickable hyperlinks. Previously, file links in agent responses showed only the file name, making file locations impossible to identify in terminals that cannot open clickable links (such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH). Labels now explicitly display the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed links to files in agent responses showing only the file name, which made the file's location impossible to tell in terminals that cannot open clickable links, such as Terminal.app, `screen`, or over SSH; labels now show the path relative to your working directory, relative to `~/`, or the absolute path.

title.zh-TW: 子代理人與工作者完整保留暫存變更，支援大型目錄獨立副本
title.en: Subagents and workers fully retain uncommitted changes, supporting isolated copies for large directories

body.zh-TW: 請子代理人或蜂群工作者分頭修改程式碼時，若未提交的修改無法同步會造成進度混亂。以前子代理人與蜂群工作者取得 Git 專案副本時只會從最後一次提交開始，導致尚未提交的改動全部遺失。現在它們的工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）會完整包含已暫存、未暫存與未追蹤的所有變更。即使專案未納入版本控制，也能為工作者提供隔離的工作區資料夾，支援上限達 100,000 個項目與 4 GiB 容量。這個問題已經修好。
body.en: When asking subagents or swarm workers to modify code separately, failing to sync uncommitted changes causes confusion. Previously, when subagents and swarm workers obtained copies of a Git repository, they only started from the last commit, causing all uncommitted work to be lost. Now their worktree (a Git feature that opens multiple parallel copies of the same project) fully includes all staged, unstaged, and untracked changes. Even if a project is not under version control, the CLI can provide workers with an isolated workspace folder, supporting limits up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB in size. This issue has been fixed.

items.original: Fixed subagents and swarm workers that get their own copy of a Git repository starting from the last commit and losing your uncommitted work; their worktree now includes your staged, unstaged, and untracked changes, and agents outside version control can give a subagent or worker an isolated copy of the workspace folder, for folders up to 100,000 entries and 4 GiB.

entries: Added Auto mode to `agy acp` sessions, so editors can switch a session to `auto` wherever the CLI itself offers Auto mode; it approves edits inside the workspace and runs commands in the terminal sandbox, and still asks before commands that would leave the sandbox unless Auto mode's review clears them.

Added `hookEventName`, `cwd`, and `toolCall.id` to the JSON input that hooks receive, so a single hook command can handle several events, knows the agent's working directory, and can match a `PostToolUse` call to its `PreToolUse` call.
Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it decides faster and times out less often, by using a lighter-thinking Gemini Flash model for the review.

Fixed `agy acp` sessions dropping back to the default mode when an editor reloaded or resumed an open session, so a session in `accept-edits` no longer starts asking for permission on file writes again.

Fixed `agy acp` turns hanging when a tool call needed a second permission approval, such as a command that asks again after its first approval; the editor now receives a new permission request instead of the turn waiting forever.

Fixed crashes and freezes with subagents: the CLI no longer crashes when a subagent's question or approval prompt is drawn in a very narrow terminal or before the terminal size is known, a subagent's question no longer closes by itself while you are answering it, and opening a subagent's view no longer occasionally freezes the CLI.

Fixed `PgUp` and `PgDn` in the conversation skipping text: paging down could jump past an entire message when a page ended exactly on a message boundary, and in `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode the lines hidden under the pinned prompt header were scrolled past without ever being shown.
Fixed a thought that follows a tool's result line, such as `Read 22 lines`, being indented as if it were part of that tool call in the expanded view (`Ctrl+O`).

Fixed the `remote-control` background service staying disconnected for good when it started before the network was up, such as right after a reboot, and stopped it from printing a sign-in link it could not complete when checking the saved sign-in only hit a network error.

Fixed the selected Gemini Enterprise plan being lost, and requests failing with permission errors, when the stored sign-in grew too large for the Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain; sign-ins that were already affected are repaired automatically the next time they load.

Fixed the `Sign-in update needed` warning, which asks you to run `/logout` and sign in again when your sign-in is missing a newly required permission, not appearing in `--remote-agent` sessions, where only a `cloud conversations are not enabled` error was shown.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 支援 Auto 模式，沙盒外指令審查改用輕量模型加速
title.en: agy acp adds Auto mode, speeding up out-of-sandbox command reviews with a lightweight model

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣在編輯器裡透過 `agy acp` 協同編輯程式碼，現在也能享受到自動執行的便利。只要命令列介面有提供 Auto 模式，編輯器就能將目前的工作階段切換至 `auto`。開啟後，工具會自動核准工作區內部的編輯，並在終端機沙盒內執行指令。如果指令打算脫離沙盒，除非審查判定通過，否則依然會先停下來徵求你的許可。⟦就像聘請駐點秘書處理公文一樣，以前每份單據都要親筆簽名；現在辦公室內的常態開銷直接放行，跨部門的特殊款項才交由主管快速過目。⟧針對脫離終端機沙盒的指令審查，現在改由思考負載較輕的 Gemini Flash 模型負責，讓審查判定更迅速，也降低了逾時的發生機率。
body.en: If you are used to co-editing code in your editor through `agy acp`, you can now enjoy the convenience of automatic execution. As long as the command line interface offers Auto mode, the editor can switch the current session to `auto`. Once enabled, the tool automatically approves edits inside the workspace and runs commands in the terminal sandbox. If a command intends to leave the sandbox, it still pauses to ask for your permission unless the review clears it. ⟦Think of hiring an on-site secretary to handle official paperwork: previously every invoice required a handwritten signature, whereas routine in-office expenses are now approved directly and only special cross-department payments are passed to a manager for quick review.⟧ For reviewing commands that leave the terminal sandbox, a lighter-thinking Gemini Flash model now handles the review, making review decisions faster and reducing the chances of timeouts.

items.original:
Added Auto mode to `agy acp` sessions, so editors can switch a session to `auto` wherever the CLI itself offers Auto mode; it approves edits inside the workspace and runs commands in the terminal sandbox, and still asks before commands that would leave the sandbox unless Auto mode's review clears them.
Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox so it decides faster and times out less often, by using a lighter-thinking Gemini Flash model for the review.

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤輸入資料擴充，單一指令即可識別事件、目錄與工具調用
title.en: Hook input data expands to let a single command identify events, directories, and tool calls

body.zh-TW: 當你編寫自訂腳本來監聽 AI 的各種操作時，現在能直接取得更豐富的當下情境。掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）接收的 JSON 輸入資料中，新增了 `hookEventName`、`cwd` 與 `toolCall.id` 三個欄位。這讓單一掛鉤指令就能同時處理多種不同事件，而且隨時知道代理目前的工作目錄。當工具執行完畢發出 `PostToolUse` 調用時，也能藉由編號精準對應到執行前的 `PreToolUse` 調用。⟦跟快遞收發室登記單一樣，以前回執聯只蓋單一戳章，分不清送達哪一棟樓；現在單據印上事件類別、辦公室位置與追蹤碼，同一名管理員就能把派件前後的簽收完整串聯起來。⟧
body.en: When you write custom scripts to listen to various AI operations, you can now directly obtain richer contextual details. In the JSON input received by hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), three new fields have been added: `hookEventName`, `cwd`, and `toolCall.id`. This allows a single hook command to handle multiple different events while knowing the agent's current working directory at any time. When a `PostToolUse` call is emitted after tool execution finishes, it can also accurately match the `PreToolUse` call prior to execution using the identifier. ⟦Picture a courier mailroom log sheet: previously the receipt slip carried only a single stamp and could not identify which building received the delivery, but now the slip prints the event type, office location, and tracking code so the same clerk can tie the sign-offs before and after dispatch together.⟧

items.original: Added `hookEventName`, `cwd`, and `toolCall.id` to the JSON input that hooks receive, so a single hook command can handle several events, knows the agent's working directory, and can match a `PostToolUse` call to its `PreToolUse` call.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 工作階段修復：重載保留自訂模式，二次授權不再停擺
title.en: agy acp session fixes: reloads preserve custom modes and second authorizations no longer hang

body.zh-TW:
透過編輯器重新連線或接續既有對話時，操作模式與授權詢問現在能順暢延續。

以前當編輯器重新載入或恢復已開啟的工作階段時，會退回預設模式。即使你先前已切換至自動接受修改的 `accept-edits` 模式，寫入檔案時依然會重新要求確認權限。現在工作階段會完整保留原本的設定，不再重複發出詢問。

當工具調用需要第二次授權批准時（例如某道指令在首次核准後又再次要求確認），過去對話輪次會直接卡死並無止境等待。現在編輯器會正常收到新的權限請求，讓你順利完成授權。
body.en:
When reconnecting or resuming an existing conversation through an editor, operating modes and authorization prompts now continue smoothly.

Previously, when an editor reloaded or resumed an open session, it dropped back to the default mode. Even if you had previously switched to `accept-edits` mode to automatically accept modifications, file writes still asked for permission confirmation again. Sessions now fully retain their original settings without asking repeatedly.

When a tool call needed a second permission approval (such as a command asking for confirmation again after its first approval), conversation turns previously hung and waited indefinitely. Editors now properly receive the new permission request, allowing you to complete authorization smoothly.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` sessions dropping back to the default mode when an editor reloaded or resumed an open session, so a session in `accept-edits` no longer starts asking for permission on file writes again.
Fixed `agy acp` turns hanging when a tool call needed a second permission approval, such as a command that asks again after its first approval; the editor now receives a new permission request instead of the turn waiting forever.

title.zh-TW: 子代理視窗與互動修復，窄螢幕提問不再崩潰或畫面凍結
title.en: Subagent window and interaction fixes: narrow terminal prompts no longer crash or freeze the display

body.zh-TW: 當你委派子代理（在背景獨立執行分工任務的輔助代理）協同工作時，各項視窗互動現在更加穩定。以前若終端機視窗過窄，或是尺寸尚未偵測完成，繪製子代理的提問與核准提示會導致工具當機。你正在回答問題時提示框也可能自行關閉，切換檢視畫面甚至會偶爾凍結終端機。現在這些異常都已修復，操作流程不再無故中斷。
body.en: When you delegate tasks to subagents (auxiliary agents that run divided work independently in the background), window interactions are now more stable. Previously, if the terminal window was overly narrow or its dimensions had not yet been detected, drawing a subagent's question or approval prompt caused the tool to crash. While you were answering a question, the prompt box could also close on its own, and switching the view could occasionally freeze the terminal. These issues have now all been resolved, preventing unexpected workflow disruptions.

items.original: Fixed crashes and freezes with subagents: the CLI no longer crashes when a subagent's question or approval prompt is drawn in a very narrow terminal or before the terminal size is known, a subagent's question no longer closes by itself while you are answering it, and opening a subagent's view no longer occasionally freezes the CLI.

title.zh-TW: 對話瀏覽與展開視圖修復，翻頁不漏行且思考區塊正確對齊
title.en: Conversation browsing and expanded view fixes: paging no longer skips lines and thinking blocks align properly

body.zh-TW:
在終端機上下翻閱長篇對話時，畫面不再莫名跳行或排版錯置。

以前按下 `PgUp` 與 `PgDn` 翻頁時，若頁面底端剛好停在訊息邊界，向下翻頁會直接跳過整則訊息。在全螢幕（altscreen）渲染模式中，被置頂提示標頭遮住的文字行也會在捲動時被略過，完全沒有顯示在螢幕上。

另外在按下 `Ctrl+O` 切換至展開視圖時，緊接在工具結果行（例如 `Read 22 lines`）後方的思考區塊，先前會被額外縮排，導致看起來像屬於該工具調用的一部分。現在排版與捲動都已修復，瀏覽完整歷史紀錄時不會再漏看訊息。
body.en:
When scrolling up and down through long conversations in the terminal, the display no longer unexpectedly skips lines or misaligns formatting.

Previously, when paging with `PgUp` and `PgDn`, scrolling down could jump past an entire message if a page ended right on a message boundary. In full screen (altscreen) rendering mode, text lines hidden under the pinned prompt header were also skipped during scrolling without ever being shown on screen.

Additionally, when pressing `Ctrl+O` to switch to the expanded view, a thinking block immediately following a tool result line (such as `Read 22 lines`) was previously indented further, making it look like part of that tool call. Layout and scrolling have now both been repaired, ensuring you won't miss messages when reviewing complete history.

items.original:
Fixed `PgUp` and `PgDn` in the conversation skipping text: paging down could jump past an entire message when a page ended exactly on a message boundary, and in `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode the lines hidden under the pinned prompt header were scrolled past without ever being shown.
Fixed a thought that follows a tool's result line, such as `Read 22 lines`, being indented as if it were part of that tool call in the expanded view (`Ctrl+O`).

title.zh-TW: 遠端連線與登入憑證修復：排查開機斷線、金鑰容量上限與權限更新提示
title.en: Remote connection and sign-in credential fixes: resolving boot disconnections, key size limits, and permission update prompts

body.zh-TW:
在跨裝置連線或管理帳號憑證時，各項開機連線與授權更新的異常問題均已修復。

若 `remote-control` 背景服務在網路就緒前啟動（例如剛開機時），過去會永久斷線且印出無效登入連結，現已修復。

當存放在 Windows 認證管理員或 macOS 鑰匙圈等憑證庫（存登入證明的地方）的資料過大時，過去會遺失 Gemini Enterprise 方案並引發權限錯誤，受影響資料下次載入時會自動修復。

提示執行 `/logout` 重新登入的 `Sign-in update needed` 警告，過去在 `--remote-agent` 工作階段中會被漏掉，現在已會正確顯示。
body.en:
When connecting across devices or managing account credentials, various issues with boot connections and authorization updates have been resolved.

If the `remote-control` background service started before the network was ready (such as right after booting), it previously disconnected permanently and printed an invalid sign-in link, which has now been fixed.

When data stored in credential stores (places that store login proofs) such as Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain grew too large, the Gemini Enterprise plan was previously lost and caused permission errors, and affected data is automatically repaired the next time it loads.

The `Sign-in update needed` warning that prompts running `/logout` to sign in again was previously omitted in `--remote-agent` sessions, and is now properly displayed.

items.original:
Fixed the `remote-control` background service staying disconnected for good when it started before the network was up, such as right after a reboot, and stopped it from printing a sign-in link it could not complete when checking the saved sign-in only hit a network error.
Fixed the selected Gemini Enterprise plan being lost, and requests failing with permission errors, when the stored sign-in grew too large for the Windows Credential Manager or macOS Keychain; sign-ins that were already affected are repaired automatically the next time they load.
Fixed the `Sign-in update needed` warning, which asks you to run `/logout` and sign in again when your sign-in is missing a newly required permission, not appearing in `--remote-agent` sessions, where only a `cloud conversations are not enabled` error was shown.

entries: Added each subagent's model next to its name in the subagent rows above the prompt and in `/agents` (hidden on narrow terminals), with the full model and effort in a subagent's detail view, and a `model` field on each `subagents` entry in the status line JSON; `/agents` now shows a single `Tip: Press enter on a subagent to view details.` line instead of repeating `[view details]` on every row.

Added the `PLUGIN_ROOT` and `PLUGIN_DATA` environment variables to hook commands that come from a plugin, pointing to the plugin's folder and its persistent data folder, so plugin hooks can use files bundled with the plugin and keep state between runs; `agy plugin validate` no longer warns that these variables are not set for hooks.

Changed the error shown when Vertex AI reports that the selected model does not exist or that your Google Cloud project cannot use it, which now reads `The requested model was not found, or your project does not have access to it.` instead of the raw API error.

Improved the plugin sign-in screen in `/plugin`, which now indents the sign-in link like the surrounding text and sets it apart with a blank line, no longer underlines trailing blank space in wrapped links, and uses the plugin's display name from `plugin.json`, such as `Canva` instead of `canva`.
Improved `agy plugin validate` so the `category` field in `plugin.json` is accepted instead of reported as an unknown field, with a warning only when it is not a non-empty string.
Improved auto-generated conversation titles, which now keep abbreviations and acronyms from your request as written instead of guessing what they stand for.

Fixed `agy plugin uninstall`, `agy plugin enable`, `agy plugin disable`, and uninstalling from `/plugin` failing for plugins installed as symbolic links, such as plugins installed from Antigravity, or for plugins whose names contain spaces or symbols such as `c++-tools`, and `agy plugin list` shows symlinked plugins again.
Fixed agent turns failing with `http2: timeout awaiting response headers` when the model took more than 60 seconds to start responding, which are now retried.
Fixed every model request failing with a 404 error when an enterprise model gateway URL ended in `/v1beta`, even though the model list loaded; a trailing `/v1beta` in the gateway URL is now ignored.

Fixed the agent's requests to sign in to a plugin being dropped from the conversation, so when a plugin needs a sign-in the CLI now shows a line such as `⚠ The <plugin> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.`

Fixed the agent's file tools mishandling text that is not UTF-8, mostly on Windows: reading a UTF-16 or legacy code-page file now returns its text instead of treating it as binary, edits keep a file's UTF-8 byte order mark or UTF-16 encoding, and PowerShell scripts (`.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.psd1`) with non-ASCII text are written with a UTF-8 byte order mark so Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads them correctly.
Fixed a message sent during a turn with the `Send Immediately` queued-messages mode briefly disappearing from the conversation and reappearing when it arrived just as the turn ended.
Fixed hooks receiving a placeholder or empty model name when the session uses a custom model, so hooks now get the name of the model actually in use.

Fixed files larger than the remote read limit being silently cut off in `--remote-agent` sessions, which now load in full up to 20 MiB and report an error above that instead of showing partial content.
Fixed `agy acp` sessions exiting before the agent backend finished shutting down when the client closed the connection, which could interrupt saving conversation data.

Fixed a security issue where a command run in the terminal sandbox could change environment state later loaded by persistent terminal commands run outside the sandbox, and hardened persistent terminal IDs against path traversal.
Fixed garbled characters in tool-call summaries when the CLI shortens file paths that contain non-ASCII characters.

Fixed paths that share a prefix with your home directory, such as `/home/alice` when your home is `/home/al`, showing with a mangled `~` prefix in the `/context` file list and the keybindings reset hint.

title.zh-TW: 子代理列出運作模型，詳細畫面可查思考力度
title.en: Subagents List Their Running Models, and Detail Views Show Thinking Effort

body.zh-TW: 當你在對話中啟用多個子代理分工時，能一眼看清每位助理背後運作的模型。現在輸入框上方的子代理清單與 `/agents` 列表中，代理名稱旁會直接標註所使用的模型，遇到寬度較窄的終端機則會自動隱藏。⟦就像瀏覽球隊的出賽名單，以前名牌上只印球員名字，看不出誰是主力；現在名字旁直接列出階級，點開詳情還能掌握每位選手的投入程度。⟧進入子代理詳細檢視畫面，還能查看完整模型名稱與思考力度設定。如果你透過 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）讀取 JSON 資料，每筆 `subagents` 項目也補上了 `model` 欄位。`/agents` 列表不再每行重複顯示 `[view details]`，改在下方顯示單行 `Tip: Press enter on a subagent to view details.` 提示。
body.en: When delegating tasks to multiple subagents in a conversation, you can immediately see the model running behind each assistant. In the subagent rows above the prompt and in `/agents`, the model in use is now marked directly next to each agent's name, and it is automatically hidden on narrow terminals. ⟦Think of checking a team roster where placards previously showed only player names without revealing starters; now each name displays their tier, and opening details reveals each player's level of effort.⟧ Entering a subagent's detail view also lets you see the full model name and effort setting. If you read JSON data through the status line (the status bar displayed at the bottom of the terminal), a `model` field has also been added to each `subagents` entry. The `/agents` list no longer repeats `[view details]` on every row, instead displaying a single `Tip: Press enter on a subagent to view details.` line below.

items.original: Added each subagent's model next to its name in the subagent rows above the prompt and in `/agents` (hidden on narrow terminals), with the full model and effort in a subagent's detail view, and a `model` field on each `subagents` entry in the status line JSON; `/agents` now shows a single `Tip: Press enter on a subagent to view details.` line instead of repeating `[view details]` on every row.

title.zh-TW: 外掛掛鉤支援專屬目錄，驗證工具接納分類欄位
title.en: Plugin Hooks Gain Dedicated Directories, and Validation Accepts Category Field

body.zh-TW:
開發或客製化外掛時，掛鉤程式現在能精準存取自身檔案並取得運作資訊。來自外掛的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）指令，現在新增了 `PLUGIN_ROOT` 與 `PLUGIN_DATA` 兩個環境變數，分別指向外掛所在的目錄與會保留資料的目錄，方便掛鉤使用隨附檔案並在多次執行間保留狀態。執行 `agy plugin validate` 時，不會再針對掛鉤未設定這兩個變數發出警告。

執行 `agy plugin validate` 檢查時，`plugin.json` 設定檔內的 `category` 分類欄位已被正式接納，不再誤報為未知欄位，僅在內容不是非空字串時提出警告。在工作階段使用自訂模型時，過去掛鉤常收到預留位置或空名稱，現在會確實取得當前運作的模型名稱。
body.en:
When developing or customizing plugins, hook programs can now accurately access their own files and retrieve runtime information. Hook commands coming from a plugin now add the `PLUGIN_ROOT` and `PLUGIN_DATA` environment variables, pointing respectively to the plugin's folder and its persistent data folder. This allows hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) to use bundled files and preserve state across runs. Running `agy plugin validate` no longer warns that these variables are not set for hooks.

When running `agy plugin validate`, the `category` field in the `plugin.json` configuration file is now officially accepted instead of reported as an unknown field, with a warning issued only when it is not a non-empty string. When using a custom model in a session, hooks previously often received a placeholder or empty name, but they now reliably receive the name of the model actually in use.

items.original:
Added the `PLUGIN_ROOT` and `PLUGIN_DATA` environment variables to hook commands that come from a plugin, pointing to the plugin's folder and its persistent data folder, so plugin hooks can use files bundled with the plugin and keep state between runs; `agy plugin validate` no longer warns that these variables are not set for hooks.
Improved `agy plugin validate` so the `category` field in `plugin.json` is accepted instead of reported as an unknown field, with a warning only when it is not a non-empty string.
Fixed hooks receiving a placeholder or empty model name when the session uses a custom model, so hooks now get the name of the model actually in use.

title.zh-TW: 外掛管理支援符號連結，登入畫面與提示排版整齊
title.en: Plugin Management Supports Symlinks, Tidying Sign-In Screens and Prompts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機安裝、停用或登入各類外掛時，介面排版與特殊路徑的支援都補齊了。如果外掛以符號連結（symlink，指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）方式安裝，或名稱含有空格與符號，過去執行 `agy plugin uninstall`、`agy plugin enable`、`agy plugin disable` 或從 `/plugin` 移除時常會失敗，現在均已修復，且 `agy plugin list` 能重新列出符號連結外掛。

在 `/plugin` 登入畫面中，登入連結會正常縮排並以空行隔開，折行不再替結尾空白加底線，名稱也會改採 `plugin.json` 的顯示名稱。當外掛需要登入時，請求不會再從對話消失，終端機會提示 `⚠ The <plugin> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.`。
body.en:
When installing, disabling, or signing in to plugins in the terminal, interface layouts and support for special paths are now fully rounded out. If a plugin was installed as a symbolic link (a shortcut pointing to another location) or has a name containing spaces or symbols, running `agy plugin uninstall`, `agy plugin enable`, `agy plugin disable`, or uninstalling from `/plugin` previously often failed; these issues are now fixed, and `agy plugin list` displays symlinked plugins again.

In the `/plugin` sign-in screen, sign-in links are now properly indented and set apart with a blank line, wrapped links no longer underline trailing blank space, and names use the display name from `plugin.json`. When a plugin requires a sign-in, requests are no longer dropped from the conversation, and the terminal displays a line such as `⚠ The <plugin> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.`.

items.original:
Improved the plugin sign-in screen in `/plugin`, which now indents the sign-in link like the surrounding text and sets it apart with a blank line, no longer underlines trailing blank space in wrapped links, and uses the plugin's display name from `plugin.json`, such as `Canva` instead of `canva`.
Fixed `agy plugin uninstall`, `agy plugin enable`, `agy plugin disable`, and uninstalling from `/plugin` failing for plugins installed as symbolic links, such as plugins installed from Antigravity, or for plugins whose names contain spaces or symbols such as `c++-tools`, and `agy plugin list` shows symlinked plugins again.
Fixed the agent's requests to sign in to a plugin being dropped from the conversation, so when a plugin needs a sign-in the CLI now shows a line such as `⚠ The <plugin> plugin needs you to sign in. Open /plugin to sign in.`

title.zh-TW: 企業模型閘道修復路徑錯誤，模型逾時自動重試
title.en: Enterprise Model Gateways Fix Path Errors, and Model Timeouts Auto-Retry

body.zh-TW: 連線至雲端模型或企業內部閘道時，網路延遲與路徑設定常影響對話能否順利展開。⟦宛如撥打跨國總機電話，以前只要線路忙線超過一分鐘就被直接切斷，分機號碼多帶斜線還會轉到空號；現在遇上線路延遲會自動重撥，轉接號碼多打尾碼也會自動校正接通。⟧當模型超過 60 秒才開始回傳標頭時，代理不會再以 `http2: timeout awaiting response headers` 中斷失敗，而是會主動重試。若企業模型閘道（gateway）網址結尾帶有 `/v1beta`，系統會自動忽略該後綴，避免請求全數回傳 404 錯誤。透過 Vertex AI 呼叫模型時，若模型不存在或專案無權限，錯誤訊息改以 `The requested model was not found, or your project does not have access to it.` 取代原始 API 報錯。
body.en: When connecting to cloud models or enterprise internal gateways, network latency and path configurations often affect whether conversations start smoothly. ⟦Picture dialing an international switchboard where lines busy for over a minute were abruptly disconnected and an extra slash in the extension forwarded to a dead line; now line delays trigger an automatic redial, and accidental trailing suffixes in the extension are corrected to connect.⟧ When a model takes more than 60 seconds to begin returning response headers, agent turns no longer fail with `http2: timeout awaiting response headers` and are retried instead. If an enterprise model gateway URL ends in `/v1beta`, the system automatically ignores that suffix to prevent every request from failing with a 404 error. When calling models through Vertex AI, if the requested model does not exist or your project lacks permissions, the error message now displays `The requested model was not found, or your project does not have access to it.` instead of the raw API error.

items.original:
Changed the error shown when Vertex AI reports that the selected model does not exist or that your Google Cloud project cannot use it, which now reads `The requested model was not found, or your project does not have access to it.` instead of the raw API error.
Fixed agent turns failing with `http2: timeout awaiting response headers` when the model took more than 60 seconds to start responding, which are now retried.
Fixed every model request failing with a 404 error when an enterprise model gateway URL ended in `/v1beta`, even though the model list loaded; a trailing `/v1beta` in the gateway URL is now ignored.

title.zh-TW: 對話標題保留英文縮寫，送出排隊訊息不再閃爍消失
title.en: Conversation Titles Keep Abbreviations, and Queued Messages No Longer Flicker Away

body.zh-TW:
日常使用對話視窗交辦任務時，文字顯示與歷史紀錄保存變得更為可靠。現在自動產生的對話標題，會依你在提問中輸入的原樣保留英文簡寫與首字母縮寫，不再自行猜測並展開全名。

當你使用立即送出（Send Immediately）排隊訊息模式時，若在上一輪剛好結束的瞬間送出訊息，過去常在對話中短暫消失又重新出現，這個問題已經修好。

如果你透過 `agy acp` 連線工作階段，過去當用戶端切斷連線時，常在代理後端關閉前過早退出，容易打斷對話紀錄的儲存；這個問題已經修好，對話資料不會再因此在儲存途中被打斷。
body.en:
When assigning tasks in daily conversation windows, text display and history retention have become more reliable. Auto-generated conversation titles now preserve abbreviations and acronyms as originally written in your request, without guessing and expanding their full names.

When using the `Send Immediately` queued-messages mode, sending a message right as the previous turn ended previously caused it to briefly disappear and reappear in the conversation; this issue is now resolved.

If you connect to sessions via `agy acp`, client disconnections previously caused sessions to exit prematurely before the agent backend finished shutting down, which could easily interrupt saving conversation history; this issue is now fixed so conversation data is no longer cut short during saving.

items.original:
Improved auto-generated conversation titles, which now keep abbreviations and acronyms from your request as written instead of guessing what they stand for.
Fixed a message sent during a turn with the `Send Immediately` queued-messages mode briefly disappearing from the conversation and reappearing when it arrived just as the turn ended.
Fixed `agy acp` sessions exiting before the agent backend finished shutting down when the client closed the connection, which could interrupt saving conversation data.

title.zh-TW: 檔案工具支援舊版編碼頁，遠端讀取上限放寬至 20 MiB
title.en: File Tools Support Legacy Code Pages, and Remote Read Limit Expands to 20 MiB

body.zh-TW:
當代理在不同系統間讀取程式碼或路徑時，非標準編碼與長路徑常引發解析異常。在 Windows 環境下，檔案工具讀取 UTF-16 與傳統編碼頁文字時不再誤判為二進位檔，編輯時也會保留 UTF-16 編碼或既有的 UTF-8 位元組順序記號（BOM）。寫入含非 ASCII 字元的 PowerShell 腳本時也會加上 UTF-8 BOM，讓 Windows PowerShell 5.1 能正確讀取。

使用 `--remote-agent` 遠端工作階段時，超過讀取限制的檔案不再被悄悄截斷，最高可完整讀取 20 MiB，超過上限則明確報錯。此外，工具呼叫摘要縮短非 ASCII 路徑時已修正亂碼，路徑與家目錄前綴重疊時也不再於 `/context` 清單顯示損壞的 `~` 符號。
body.en:
When the agent reads code or paths across different systems, non-standard encodings and long paths often trigger parsing anomalies. On Windows, file tools reading UTF-16 and legacy code-page text no longer misidentify files as binary, and edits preserve UTF-16 encoding or existing UTF-8 byte order marks (BOMs). Writing PowerShell scripts containing non-ASCII characters also attaches a UTF-8 BOM so that Windows PowerShell 5.1 can read them properly.

In `--remote-agent` remote sessions, files exceeding the read limit are no longer silently truncated, loading fully up to 20 MiB and reporting a clear error above that limit. In addition, garbled characters have been fixed when tool-call summaries shorten paths containing non-ASCII characters, and paths sharing a prefix with your home directory no longer show a broken `~` symbol in the `/context` list.

items.original:
Fixed the agent's file tools mishandling text that is not UTF-8, mostly on Windows: reading a UTF-16 or legacy code-page file now returns its text instead of treating it as binary, edits keep a file's UTF-8 byte order mark or UTF-16 encoding, and PowerShell scripts (`.ps1`, `.psm1`, `.psd1`) with non-ASCII text are written with a UTF-8 byte order mark so Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads them correctly.
Fixed files larger than the remote read limit being silently cut off in `--remote-agent` sessions, which now load in full up to 20 MiB and report an error above that instead of showing partial content.
Fixed garbled characters in tool-call summaries when the CLI shortens file paths that contain non-ASCII characters.
Fixed paths that share a prefix with your home directory, such as `/home/alice` when your home is `/home/al`, showing with a mangled `~` prefix in the `/context` file list and the keybindings reset hint.

title.zh-TW: 隔離終端機沙盒環境狀態，強化連線識別碼安全性
title.en: Terminal Sandbox State Is Isolated, Hardening Connection ID Security

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機沙盒中執行不受信任的指令時，本機環境的隔離防護變得更為嚴密。⟦如同在密閉防護艙內試驗原料，以前艙內殘留的氣體可能滲漏到外部常態作業區，控制台識別碼也缺乏防護；現在內部操作徹底阻斷外洩，終端編號也強化防禦以防止越區穿透。⟧過去在終端機沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行指令的受限環境）內執行的指令，曾可能改動環境狀態，導致沙盒外部執行的常駐終端機指令載入受污染的設定。這個安全問題已經修好，沙盒內的狀態變更不會再影響外部終端機。常駐終端機的連線識別碼也針對路徑遍歷（path traversal）加強了防護。
body.en: When running untrusted commands in a terminal sandbox, local environment isolation becomes significantly tighter. ⟦Like testing raw materials inside a sealed containment chamber where residual gases once leaked into routine work areas outside while console IDs lacked protection, internal operations now thoroughly block leaks and terminal numbers are fortified against cross-zone traversal.⟧ Commands run inside the terminal sandbox (an isolated, restricted environment for running commands) previously could alter environment state, causing persistent terminal commands run outside the sandbox to load contaminated configurations. This security issue has been resolved, so state changes inside the sandbox no longer affect external terminals. Connection IDs for persistent terminals have also been hardened against path traversal.

items.original: Fixed a security issue where a command run in the terminal sandbox could change environment state later loaded by persistent terminal commands run outside the sandbox, and hardened persistent terminal IDs against path traversal.

entries: Added skills from the cloud plugins you connected with `/plugin` to `--remote-agent` sessions, so they now appear in the `/` menu and can be typed at the start of a message, `/skills` lists them grouped by plugin under `Remote agent skills`, and `/skills reload` lists them again.

Changed the default for macOS Option-key shortcuts such as `alt+m`, which now work out of the box without setting Option to act as Alt in your terminal, where previously pressing them did nothing or typed a character such as `µ`; set `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` to go back to the old behavior.

Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so commands on the built-in list of protected commands are no longer approved automatically and go through the usual checks, while every other command still runs without asking.

Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and plugin agents set to auto-allow so they no longer approve terminal commands or file access outside the workspace when your Gemini Enterprise administrator requires those to be reviewed, and headless runs now deny such requests instead.

Changed the prompt shown when the agent asks for access to a file outside the workspace, which now reads `Allow access to this file?` and offers to always allow or deny that one path for the conversation or in `settings.json`, instead of turning on access to everything outside the workspace.
Improved `agy -p` runs so they no longer make a background model request to generate a conversation title that print mode never shows.
Improved Remote Control connections, which now retry a brief network or server error while setting up a new connection instead of dropping it.

Improved `agy plugin validate` so an unknown field under `extensions["com.google.antigravity"]` in `plugin.json` is reported as a warning that the field is ignored instead of an error, and the plugin's other extension settings are still checked.

Improved protection against malicious plugins: `agy plugin` import, install, uninstall, enable, and disable now reject plugin names that are not safe file names with `invalid plugin name`, and refuse to write outside the plugins folder or through symbolic links, so an imported plugin can no longer overwrite other configuration files such as `mcp_config.json`.

Improved protection against untrusted repositories: plugins and skills listed in a workspace's `.agents/plugins.json` or `.agents/skills.json` now load only from inside the workspace or its repository root, and entries that point elsewhere through absolute paths, `../`, or symbolic links are skipped.

Fixed subagents stalling for about 60 seconds on file permissions under `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, so reads and writes outside the workspace now go through without a prompt, and headless `-p` runs with the flag no longer wait on any remaining interaction, while your explicit deny rules still apply.

Fixed signing in to an MCP server that uses OAuth failing with `Invalid PKCE code_verifier` when the server reconnected during sign-in, such as when `/mcp` reloaded servers or a new turn started, so the sign-in link you already opened keeps working.

Fixed MCP tools that declare their own `explanation`, `toolSummary`, `toolAction`, or `waitForPreviousTools` parameter receiving calls without that argument, so the value the model sends now reaches the tool.
Fixed the agent re-running a failed turn in a rapid loop when messages were queued at the moment it hit an error, so queued messages now wait for your next message.

Fixed the `/` menu listing the commands and skills of a default agent instead of those of the agent the session actually runs, so in `agy acp` sessions it now shows that session's agent, including a custom agent's commands.
Fixed adding PDFs, other binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB to a remote project from `/projects` in `--remote-agent` sessions, which failed and now upload successfully.
Fixed voice dictation in Chinese and Japanese showing a space between every character in the live draft before the final transcript arrived, and fullwidth Latin words losing the spaces between them.

title.zh-TW: 遠端代理支援雲端擴充技能，放寬專案大檔上傳限制
title.en: Remote agents support cloud plugin skills, lifting upload limits on large project files

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣透過 `--remote-agent` 在遠端主機執行代理任務，常需要搭配外掛技能或上傳規格書等參考資料。現在透過 `/plugin` 連線的雲端擴充套件技能，已經正式支援遠端代理工作階段。這些技能會直接顯示在斜線選單中，在訊息開頭輸入就能直接呼叫。輸入 `/skills` 會依套件分組列在遠端代理技能清單，輸入 `/skills reload` 即可重新整理。⟦跟出海科考的探險船連線一樣，以前通訊受限，既無法調用總部的專家工具箱，傳送高解析海圖還會被中斷；現在遠端船隻能隨時掛載雲端技能，大型觀測檔也能順暢送達。⟧從 `/projects` 新增 PDF、二進位檔案或大於約 8 MB 的檔案到遠端專案時，過去容易上傳失敗，現在都能順利完成上傳。
body.en: If you often run agent tasks on remote hosts with `--remote-agent`, you frequently need plugin skills or have to upload reference materials like specification documents. Cloud plugin skills connected via `/plugin` are now officially supported in remote agent sessions. These skills appear directly in the `/` menu and can be called by typing them at the start of a message. Running `/skills` lists them grouped by plugin under `Remote agent skills`, and running `/skills reload` refreshes the list. ⟦Much like staying in touch with an offshore research expedition, where limited communications once blocked access to headquarters' specialist toolkits and broke transfers of high-resolution nautical charts, the remote vessel can now attach cloud skills anytime and large observation files arrive smoothly.⟧ When adding PDFs, binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB from `/projects` to a remote project, uploads previously failed often, but now complete successfully.

items.original:
Added skills from the cloud plugins you connected with `/plugin` to `--remote-agent` sessions, so they now appear in the `/` menu and can be typed at the start of a message, `/skills` lists them grouped by plugin under `Remote agent skills`, and `/skills reload` lists them again.
Fixed adding PDFs, other binary files, or files larger than about 8 MB to a remote project from `/projects` in `--remote-agent` sessions, which failed and now upload successfully.

title.zh-TW: macOS 的 Option 快捷鍵開箱即用，免額外修改終端機設定
title.en: macOS Option-key shortcuts work out of the box without extra terminal configuration

body.zh-TW: 在 Mac 上使用命令列時，想按下 `alt+m` 等組合鍵往往會遇到按鍵無反應或打出特殊符號的困擾。macOS 版本的 Option 組合鍵預設行為迎來更新。以前在終端機裡按 Option 鍵快捷鍵時，若沒有事先把 Option 鍵設定為 Alt 鍵，按下後可能毫無反應，或者直接打出 `µ` 等特殊字元；現在這些快捷鍵開箱就能直接生效，不再需要手動修改終端機偏好設定。⟦像使用新買的遊戲鍵盤一樣，以前得先自行修改按鍵映射才能讓特殊功能鍵生效，現在接上主機就能直接辨識預設捷徑。⟧如果你仍偏好原有的輸入行為，把環境變數 `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` 這個設定設為 0，就會回到舊行為，終端機便維持舊有的按鍵對應規則。
body.en: When using the command line on a Mac, pressing key combinations such as `alt+m` often led to no response or typed unexpected special characters. The default behavior for Option-key combinations on macOS has been updated. Previously, when pressing Option-key shortcuts in your terminal without configuring Option to act as Alt beforehand, pressing them did nothing or directly typed special characters such as `µ`; now these shortcuts work right out of the box without manually changing terminal preferences. ⟦Picture plugging in a newly bought gaming keyboard: previously, you had to reconfigure key mappings yourself before special function keys worked, but now connecting it to the computer immediately recognizes default shortcuts.⟧ If you still prefer the original input behavior, setting the environment variable `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` will return to the old behavior, keeping your terminal's previous key mapping rules.

items.original: Changed the default for macOS Option-key shortcuts such as `alt+m`, which now work out of the box without setting Option to act as Alt in your terminal, where previously pressing them did nothing or typed a character such as `µ`; set `AGY_CLI_MAC_OPTION_AS_ALT=0` to go back to the old behavior.

title.zh-TW: 跳過權限模式增設安全防線，保護高風險指令並排除子代理停頓
title.en: Permission-skipping mode adds safety guardrails, protecting high-risk commands and resolving subagent stalls

body.zh-TW: 當你啟用 `--dangerously-skip-permissions` 參數跑自動化任務時，高風險操作與工作區邊界有了更清楚的防線。⟦類似拿著快速通行證進出廠區，以前只要出示證件就能進入所有庫房；現在特定管制區與管理規定仍需查驗，但一般走道上的隨行助理不再被警衛無端攔下盤查。⟧該模式不再自動放行內建清單中的受保護指令，這些指令會恢復一般審核，其餘指令仍照常免詢問執行。若企業管理員要求工作區外的指令或檔案存取必須經過審查，`--dangerously-skip-permissions` 與設為自動放行的外掛代理都不會跳過；無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）則會直接拒絕此類請求。子代理在此模式下存取工作區外檔案時，先前會卡頓約 60 秒、卡在檔案權限上，現在讀寫均可直接通行，搭配 `-p` 也不再停頓，自訂的明確拒絕規則仍維持有效。
body.en: When you enable `--dangerously-skip-permissions` to run automated tasks, high-risk operations and workspace boundaries have clearer guardrails. ⟦Think of how a fast pass works in a factory facility: previously, flashing your badge opened every storeroom, but now restricted zones and governance policies still require verification while accompanying assistants in common corridors are no longer needlessly stopped by guards.⟧ The mode no longer automatically approves commands on the built-in protected list, which now return to normal review, while other commands continue to run without asking. If enterprise administrators require commands or file access outside the workspace to be reviewed, neither `--dangerously-skip-permissions` nor plugin agents set to auto-allow will bypass those checks. In addition, headless mode (running without a terminal visual interface) now directly denies such requests. When subagents accessed files outside the workspace in this mode, they previously stalled for about 60 seconds on file permissions; both reads and writes now proceed directly without prompting, runs with `-p` no longer pause, and custom explicit deny rules remain in effect.

items.original:
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` so commands on the built-in list of protected commands are no longer approved automatically and go through the usual checks, while every other command still runs without asking.
Changed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and plugin agents set to auto-allow so they no longer approve terminal commands or file access outside the workspace when your Gemini Enterprise administrator requires those to be reviewed, and headless runs now deny such requests instead.
Fixed subagents stalling for about 60 seconds on file permissions under `--dangerously-skip-permissions`, so reads and writes outside the workspace now go through without a prompt, and headless `-p` runs with the flag no longer wait on any remaining interaction, while your explicit deny rules still apply.

title.zh-TW: 存取工作區外的檔案改為單一授權，不再一次開放全部目錄
title.en: File access outside the workspace switches to single-path authorization, ending broad directory exposure

body.zh-TW: 碰到代理需要讀取工作區外部的特定設定檔時，提示視窗不再要求你交出整個外部目錄的控制權。代理請求存取工作區外的檔案時，確認提示會明確顯示 `Allow access to this file?`。你可以針對當前指定的單一路徑，選擇在本次對話中永遠允許或拒絕，或將設定直接寫進 `settings.json`；系統不會再因為單一檔案的請求，就一口氣開放工作區外所有檔案的存取權限。⟦好比向大樓管理員借鑰匙，以前只要借用單一辦公室，就得把整棟大樓的門禁全面解鎖；現在管理員只會精準發放你指名那間會議室的感應卡，離開後其餘房間依然安全上鎖。⟧這讓你在引用公用設定或全域工具時，既能放心放行特定文件，又不必擔心整個硬碟門戶大開。
body.en: When an agent needs to read a specific configuration file outside the workspace, the prompt window no longer asks you to surrender control over the entire external directory. When an agent requests access to a file outside the workspace, the confirmation prompt clearly displays `Allow access to this file?`. You can choose to always allow or deny that single path for the current conversation, or write the setting directly into `settings.json`; the system will no longer open access to all files outside the workspace just because of a single file request. ⟦Consider borrowing keys from a building manager: whereas requesting a single office once required opening up access across the entire building, the manager now issues a keycard solely for your designated conference room, leaving all other rooms securely locked.⟧ When referencing shared configurations or global tools, this lets you confidently approve specific documents without worrying about leaving your entire hard drive wide open.

items.original: Changed the prompt shown when the agent asks for access to a file outside the workspace, which now reads `Allow access to this file?` and offers to always allow or deny that one path for the conversation or in `settings.json`, instead of turning on access to everything outside the workspace.

title.zh-TW: 修復指令選單與多任務循環錯誤，並強化遠端連線重試機制
title.en: Fixed command menus and queued message retry loops, and strengthened remote connection retries

body.zh-TW:
日常切換各類執行模式與操控通道時，幾處影響操作流暢度的小毛病現在都已獲得改善。

使用 `agy -p` 執行單次輸出時，不再於背景發送模型請求來生成終端機根本不會顯示的對話標題，省下多餘的模型等待與消耗。

建立遠端控制連線時，若在建立初期遇上短暫的網路波動或伺服器抖動，會主動重新嘗試連線，不再直接中斷離開。

代理執行出錯當下若剛好有排隊中的訊息，先前會陷入連續瘋狂重試的迴圈，現在這些排隊訊息會暫停並等待你的下一道指令。

在 `agy acp` 工作階段中，斜線選單修正為列出當前工作階段代理的指令與技能，自訂代理的專屬工具也能正常顯示，不再誤列預設代理的選項。

以前在這些情境下容易遇到連線驟斷或無效重試，現在各類執行模式都能穩定收尾。
body.en:
Several small issues that affected operational smoothness when switching across execution modes and control channels have now been resolved.

Running single outputs with `agy -p` no longer makes a background model request to generate a conversation title that the terminal never shows, saving redundant model waits and resource usage.

When establishing Remote Control connections, encountering brief network fluctuations or server jitter during initial setup now triggers automatic retries instead of immediately dropping the connection.

If messages were queued at the moment the agent encountered an error, the agent previously entered a rapid retry loop, but those queued messages now pause and wait for your next command.

In `agy acp` sessions, the `/` menu has been corrected to list the commands and skills of the agent running the session, properly displaying custom agents' dedicated tools instead of mistakenly listing the default agent's options.
